title: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) approximate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws into the loss function. In parameterized PDE families, variations in coefficients or boundary/initial conditions define distinct tasks. This makes training individual PINNs for each task computationally prohibitive, while cross-task transfer can be sensitive to task heterogeneity. While meta-learning can reduce retraining cost, existing methods often rely on a single global initialization and may suffer from negative transfer, particularly under feature-scarce coordinate inputs and limited training-task availability. We propose the Learning-Affinity Adaptive Modular Physics-Informed Neural Network (LAM-PINN), a compositional framework that leverages task-specific learning dynamics. LAM-PINN combines PDE parameters with learning-affinity metrics from brief transfer sessions to construct a task representation and cluster tasks even with coordinate-only inputs. It decomposes the model into cluster-specialized subnetworks and a shared meta network, and learns routing weights to selectively reuse modules instead of relying on a single global initialization. Across three PDE benchmarks, LAM-PINN achieves an average 19.7-fold reduction in mean squared error (MSE) on unseen tasks using only 10% of the training iterations required by conventional PINNs. These results indicate its effectiveness for generalization to unseen configurations within bounded design spaces of parameterized PDE families in resource-constrained engineering settings.

AI.tldr: LAM-PINN提出了一种组合式模块化物理信息神经网络框架，通过聚类任务和选择性重用子网络模块，在参数化PDE家族中实现高效跨任务泛化，仅需10%的训练迭代即可比传统PINN降低19.7倍MSE。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN在处理参数化PDE家族时，每个任务需要单独训练，计算成本高；跨任务迁移对任务异质性敏感；现有元学习方法依赖单一全局初始化，在坐标输入特征稀疏、训练任务有限时容易出现负迁移。
AI.method: LAM-PINN首先利用PDE参数和短期迁移会话中的学习亲和度指标构建任务表征并聚类；然后将模型分解为聚类专用子网络和共享元网络；通过学习路由权重选择性重用模块，而非依赖单一全局初始化。
AI.result: 在三个PDE基准测试上，LAM-PINN在未见过的任务上平均MSE降低19.7倍，且仅需传统PINN 10%的训练迭代。
AI.conclusion: LAM-PINN在资源受限的工程环境中，对参数化PDE家族中未见配置具有优异的泛化能力，验证了模块化组合和任务聚类策略的有效性。
idea_en: A modular physics-informed neural network framework that decomposes the model into cluster-specialized subnetworks and a shared meta network, with learnable routing weights for selective module reuse across tasks.

A method for constructing task representations by combining PDE parameters with learning-affinity metrics derived from brief transfer sessions, enabling task clustering even with coordinate-only inputs.

A technique for mitigating negative transfer in meta-learning for PINNs by routing tasks to specialized subnetwork modules based on task cluster membership rather than relying on a single global initialization.
idea_ch: 一种模块化物理信息神经网络框架，将模型分解为聚类专用子网络和共享元网络，并通过可学习的路由权重实现跨任务选择性模块重用。
一种结合PDE参数和短期迁移会话学习亲和度指标构建任务表征的方法，即使在仅输入坐标的情况下也能实现任务聚类。
一种通过基于任务聚类成员身份将任务路由到专用子网络模块而非依赖单一全局初始化的技术，用于缓解PINN元学习中的负迁移问题。

title: Binary Spiking Neural Networks as Causal Models
summary: We provide a causal analysis of Binary Spiking Neural Networks (BSNNs) to explain their behavior. We formally define a BSNN and represent its spiking activity as a binary causal model. Thanks to this causal representation, we are able to explain the output of the network by leveraging logic-based methods. In particular, we show that we can successfully use a SAT as well as a SMT solver to compute abductive explanations from this binary causal model. To illustrate our approach, we trained the BSNN on the standard MNIST dataset and applied our SAT-based and SMT-based methods to finding abductive explanations of the network's classifications based on pixel-level features. We also compared the found explanations against SHAP, a popular method used in the area of explainable AI. We show that, unlike SHAP, our approach guarantees that a found explanation does not contain completely irrelevant features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于因果模型的二值脉冲神经网络（BSNN）解释方法，通过将脉冲活动表示为二值因果模型，利用SAT/SMT求解器计算反事实解释（abductive explanations），并证明该方法能保证解释中不包含完全无关的特征，优于SHAP等传统可解释AI方法。
AI.motivation: 当前脉冲神经网络（SNN）的可解释性不足，缺乏对其行为进行因果分析的理论框架，难以解释网络决策的底层逻辑。
AI.method: 1) 将BSNN的脉冲活动形式化定义为二值因果模型；2) 利用SAT（布尔可满足性）和SMT（可满足性模理论）求解器从该因果模型中计算反事实解释（abductive explanations）；3) 在MNIST数据集上训练BSNN并提取基于像素级别的解释。
AI.result: SAT/SMT方法成功从BSNN中提取出反事实解释，且与SHAP相比，这些解释保证不包含完全无关的特征（即每个特征都是必要的）。
AI.conclusion: 基于逻辑求解器的因果解释方法能提供更严格、更可靠的BSNN解释，在特征必要性方面优于纯统计方法SHAP。
idea_en: A method for generating abductive explanations for Binary Spiking Neural Network classifications using SAT solvers on a binary causal model representation of spiking activity.
A technique for constructing a binary causal model from the spiking activity of a BSNN, enabling logic-based reasoning about network behavior.
A framework combining SAT and SMT solvers to compute guaranteed feature-necessity explanations for BSNN outputs, ensuring no irrelevant features are included.
A causal analysis approach for BSNNs that formally defines spiking activity as a binary causal model, enabling rigorous explainability.
A method for verifying explanation completeness in BSNNs by leveraging SAT-based abductive reasoning, outperforming SHAP in feature relevance guarantees.
idea_ch: 一种将BSNN的脉冲活动表示为二值因果模型的方法，为网络行为提供逻辑可推理的因果表征。
利用SAT求解器从BSNN的二值因果模型中计算反事实解释的技术，确保解释中每个特征都是必要的。
结合SAT和SMT求解器为BSNN输出生成解释的框架，保证解释中不包含无关特征。
一种基于逻辑可满足性求解的BSNN可解释性方法，与SHAP等统计方法相比能提供更强的特征必要性保证。
从BSNN的二值因果模型中提取像素级反事实解释的方法，应用于MNIST图像分类的决策解释。

title: When Your LLM Reaches End-of-Life: A Framework for Confident Model Migration in Production Systems
summary: We present a framework for migrating production Large Language Model (LLM) based systems when the underlying model reaches end-of-life or requires replacement. The key contribution is a Bayesian statistical approach that calibrates automated evaluation metrics against human judgments, enabling confident model comparison even with limited manual evaluation data. We demonstrate this framework on a commercial question-answering system serving 5.3M monthly interactions across six global regions; evaluating correctness, refusal behavior, and stylistic adherence to successfully identify suitable replacement models. The framework is broadly applicable to any enterprise deploying LLM-based products, providing a principled, reproducible methodology for model migration that balances quality assurance with evaluation efficiency. This is a capability increasingly essential as the LLM ecosystem continues to evolve rapidly and organizations manage portfolios of AI-powered services across multiple models, regions, and use cases.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于贝叶斯统计的框架，用于在底层大语言模型（LLM）达到生命周期终点或需要替换时，对生产级LLM系统进行迁移。核心是通过校准自动化评估指标与人工判断，实现有限人工评估数据下的可靠模型比较，并在一个服务530万月交互量的商业问答系统中验证成功。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生态快速演进，企业需要频繁替换底层模型（如GPT-3→GPT-4等），但缺乏系统化的迁移方法论。现有方法依赖大量人工评估（成本高、耗时长）或仅依赖自动化指标（可能不准确），需要一种既保证质量又兼顾效率的迁移框架。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯统计方法，将自动化评估指标与少量人工判断进行校准，从而在有限标注数据下实现高置信度的模型比较。框架涵盖正确性、拒绝行为、风格一致性等多个维度的评估。
AI.result: 在覆盖6个全球区域、月均530万交互的商业问答系统中成功应用该框架，找到了合适的替代模型，证明了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为部署LLM产品的企业提供了一种可复现、有原则的模型迁移方法论，在质量保证与评估效率之间取得了平衡，对管理多模型、多区域、多用例的AI服务组合的组织尤其重要。
idea_en: A Bayesian calibration framework for automated evaluation metrics against human judgments to enable confident LLM model comparison with limited manual evaluation data.
A multi-dimensional model migration evaluation method covering correctness, refusal behavior, and stylistic adherence for production LLM systems.
A production-grade LLM replacement methodology balancing evaluation efficiency and quality assurance using statistical calibration techniques.
idea_ch: 一种贝叶斯校准方法，将自动化评估指标与人工判断对齐，使得在只有少量人工评估数据的情况下，仍能高置信度地比较不同大语言模型的性能差异。
一种面向生产级大语言模型系统的多维迁移评估方案，同时考量回答正确性、拒绝行为合规性和风格一致性三个关键维度。
一种利用统计校准技术在大语言模型评估效率与质量保证之间取得平衡的生产级模型替换方法论，适用于跨区域、多用例的企业级部署场景。

title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
summary: Scientific research has long been human-led, driving new knowledge and transformative technologies through the continual revision of questions, methods and claims as evidence accumulates. Although large language model (LLM)-based agents are beginning to move beyond assisting predefined research workflows, none has yet demonstrated end-to-end autonomous discovery in a real physical system that produces a nontrivial result supported by experimental evidence. Here we introduce Qiushi Discovery Engine, an LLM-based agentic system for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform. Qiushi Engine combines nonlinear research phases, Meta-Trace memory and a dual-layer architecture to maintain adaptive and stable research trajectories across long-horizon investigations involving thousands of LLM-mediated reasoning, measurement and revision actions. It autonomously reproduces a published transmission-matrix experiment on a non-original platform and converts an abstract coherence-order theory into experimental observables, providing, to our knowledge, the first observation of this class of coherence-order structure. More importantly, in an open-ended study involving 145.9 million tokens, 3,242 LLM calls, 1,242 tool calls, 163 research notes and 44 scripts, Qiushi Engine proposes and experimentally validates optical bilinear interaction, a physical mechanism structurally analogous to a core operation in Transformer attention. This AI-discovered mechanism suggests a route towards high-speed, energy-efficient optical hardware for pairwise computation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI agentic system autonomously identifying and experimentally validating a nontrivial, previously unreported physical mechanism, marking a milestone for research-level autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于大语言模型的智能体系统——Qiushi Discovery Engine，它能够在真实光学平台上实现端到端的自主科学发现，包括复现已有实验、将抽象理论转化为实验可观测现象，并自主提出和实验验证了光学双线性相互作用这一新的物理机制，标志着AI智能体首次自主发现并实验验证非平凡的未知物理机制。
AI.motivation: 科学发现长期由人类主导，尽管基于大语言模型的智能体已开始辅助研究流程，但尚无系统能够在真实物理系统中实现端到端的自主科学发现并产生有实验证据支持的非平凡结果。
AI.method: Qiushi Engine结合了非线性研究阶段、Meta-Trace记忆和双层架构，以在涉及数千次LLM推理、测量和修正动作的长期研究中维持自适应且稳定的研究轨迹。
AI.result: 系统自主复现了已发表的传输矩阵实验；将抽象的相干阶理论转化为实验可观测现象，首次观察到该类相干阶结构；在开放研究中自主提出并实验验证了光学双线性相互作用这一新物理机制。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次证明AI智能体系统能够自主识别并实验验证非平凡的、未被报道过的物理机制，标志着研究级自主智能体的里程碑。
idea_en: An LLM agent system with nonlinear research phases that autonomously conducts end-to-end scientific discovery on real physical platforms, capable of iteratively revising hypotheses based on experimental evidence

A dual-layer architecture combined with Meta-Trace memory for maintaining adaptive and stable research trajectories across long-horizon investigations involving thousands of reasoning-measurement-revision cycles
A method for autonomously translating abstract physical theories (e.g., coherence-order theory) into concrete experimental observables and measurement protocols
An AI-discovered optical bilinear interaction mechanism structurally analogous to Transformer attention core operation, enabling high-speed energy-efficient optical hardware for pairwise computation

title: Think it, Run it: Autonomous ML pipeline generation via self-healing multi-agent AI
summary: The purpose of our paper is to develop a unified multi-agent architecture that automates end-to-end machine learning (ML) pipeline generation from datasets and natural-language (NL) goals, improving efficiency, robustness and explainability. A five-agent system is proposed to handle profiling, intent parsing, microservice recommendation, Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) construction and execution. It integrates code-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for microservice understanding, an explainable hybrid recommender combining multiple criteria, a self-healing mechanism using Large Language Model (LLM)-based error interpretation and adaptive learning from execution history. The approach is evaluated on 150 ML tasks across diverse scenarios. The system achieves an 84.7% end-to-end pipeline success rate, outperforming baseline methods. It demonstrates improved robustness through self-healing and reduces workflow development time compared to manual construction. The study introduces a novel integration of code-grounded RAG, explainable recommendation, self-healing execution and adaptive learning within a single architecture, showing that tightly coupled intelligent components can outperform isolated solutions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一的五智能体多智能体架构，通过代码增强检索、可解释推荐、自愈执行和自适应学习，实现从数据集和自然语言目标到端到端ML流水线的自动化生成，成功率达84.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习流水线生成工具缺乏端到端自动化、鲁棒性和可解释性，用户需手动配置并面临错误难以诊断修复的问题。
AI.method: 五智能体系统包括：数据剖析、意图解析、微服务推荐（代码增强RAG+可解释混合推荐）、DAG构建和DAG执行（含基于LLM的自我修复机制和自适应学习）。
AI.result: 在150个ML任务上端到端流水线成功率达84.7%，优于基线方法，自愈机制提升了鲁棒性，开发时间较手动构建大幅缩短。
AI.conclusion: 紧密耦合的智能组件（代码增强RAG、可解释推荐、自愈执行、自适应学习）在单一架构中协同工作，优于孤立解决方案，为自动化ML流水线生成提供了有效范式。
idea_en: A unified multi-agent architecture for end-to-end ML pipeline automation with five specialized agents (profiling, intent parsing, microservice recommendation, DAG construction, execution).
Code-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) method for understanding and recommending ML microservices based on code-level semantics.
An explainable hybrid recommender system for microservice selection that combines multiple evaluation criteria with interpretable outputs.
A self-healing execution mechanism using LLM-based error interpretation to automatically diagnose and fix pipeline failures.
Adaptive learning from execution history to improve future pipeline recommendations and self-healing strategies.
Integration of natural-language goal parsing with automated DAG construction for zero-manual-intervention ML workflow generation.

title: Unsupervised Electrofacies Classification and Porosity Characterization in the Offshore Keta Basin Using Wireline Logs
summary: This study presents an unsupervised machine learning workflow for electrofacies analysis in the offshore Keta Basin, Ghana, where core data are scarce. Six standard wireline logs from Well~C were analysed over a depth interval comprising approximately $11{,}195$ samples. K-means clustering was applied in multivariate log space, with the clustering structure evaluated using inertia and silhouette diagnostics. Four clusters were identified, supported by an average silhouette coefficient of approximately $0.50$, indicating moderate but meaningful separation. The resulting electrofacies exhibit systematic, depth-continuous patterns associated with variations in clay content, porosity, and rock framework properties, forming a geological continuum from shale-dominated to cleaner sandstone-dominated units. The results demonstrate that log-only, unsupervised clustering supported by quantitative metrics provides a robust and reproducible framework for subsurface characterisation. The proposed workflow offers a practical tool for early-stage formation evaluation in frontier offshore basins and a foundation for future integrated studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无监督机器学习工作流程，用于在岩心数据稀缺的加纳近海Keta盆地开展电相分析。基于六种常规测井曲线的K-means聚类识别出四个电相，平均轮廓系数约0.50，表明聚类具有中等但有意义的分离度。该工作流程为前沿海盆的早期地层评价提供了稳健、可重复的工具。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏岩心数据的海上前沿盆地，传统测井解释方法依赖人工经验且主观性强。本文旨在开发一种自动化、无监督的机器学习方法，利用常规测井数据进行电相分类，以克服数据稀缺带来的挑战，提高地层评价的客观性和可重复性。
AI.method: 研究采用K-means聚类算法对六种标准电缆测井数据（多变量对数空间）进行分析，通过惯量（inertia）和轮廓系数（silhouette diagnostics）评估聚类结构，最终确定了四个电相类别。
AI.result: 识别出四个电相，平均轮廓系数约0.50，电相呈现系统性的深度连续模式，与粘土含量、孔隙度和岩石骨架性质的变化相关，形成从页岩主导到干净砂岩主导的地质连续序列。
AI.conclusion: 基于纯测井数据的无监督聚类，结合定量评估指标，能够为地下储层表征提供稳健且可重复的框架。该工作流程适用于前沿海盆的早期地层评价，并可作为未来综合研究的基础。
idea_en: A method for electrofacies classification using unsupervised K-means clustering on multivariate wireline log data without prior core data, enabling automated subsurface characterization in frontier basins.
A workflow integrating inertia and silhouette coefficient diagnostics to quantitatively evaluate clustering quality in electrofacies analysis, ensuring robust and reproducible clustering results.

A depth-continuous electrofacies identification technique that maps shale-to-sandstone transitions systematically using only standard wireline logs (gamma ray, resistivity, neutron, density, sonic, etc.).
An automated formation evaluation pipeline for data-scarce offshore environments that converts raw well log curves into interpretable geological facies sequences.
idea_ch: 一种基于无监督K-means聚类的电相分类方法，在多变量测井对数空间中进行聚类，无需先验岩心数据即可实现前沿盆地的自动化地下表征。
一种结合惯量和轮廓系数诊断的工作流程，可定量评估电相分析中的聚类质量，确保聚类结果的稳健性和可重复性。

一种面向数据稀缺海上环境的自动化地层评价流程，将原始测井曲线转换为可解释的地质相序列。

title: TRUST: A Framework for Decentralized AI Service v.0.1
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) in high-stakes domains demand reliable verification, yet centralized approaches suffer four limitations: (1) Robustness, with single points of failure vulnerable to attacks and bias; (2) Scalability, as reasoning complexity creates bottlenecks; (3) Opacity, as hidden auditing erodes trust; and (4) Privacy, as exposed reasoning traces risk model theft. We introduce TRUST (Transparent, Robust, and Unified Services for Trustworthy AI), a decentralized framework with three innovations: (i) Hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graphs (HDAGs) that decompose Chain-of-Thought reasoning into five abstraction levels for parallel distributed auditing; (ii) the DAAN protocol, which projects multi-agent interactions into Causal Interaction Graphs (CIGs) for deterministic root-cause attribution; and (iii) a multi-tier consensus mechanism among computational checkers, LLM evaluators, and human experts with stake-weighted voting that guarantees correctness under 30% adversarial participation. We prove a Safety-Profitability Theorem ensuring honest auditors profit while malicious actors incur losses. All decisions are recorded on-chain, while privacy-by-design segmentation prevents reconstruction of proprietary logic. Across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, TRUST attains 72.4% accuracy (4-18% above baselines) and remains resilient against 20% corruption. DAAN reaches 70% root-cause attribution (vs. 54-63% for standard methods) with 60% token savings. Human studies validate the design (F1 = 0.89, Brier = 0.074). The framework supports (A1) decentralized auditing, (A2) tamper-proof leaderboards, (A3) trustless data annotation, and (A4) governed autonomous agents, pioneering decentralized AI auditing for safe, accountable deployment of reasoning-capable systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRUST框架，一个去中心化的AI审计系统，通过HDAG分层分解推理过程、DAAN协议进行因果归因、多层级共识机制确保安全性，在容忍30%恶意节点下实现72.4%准确率，解决了集中式审计的鲁棒性、可扩展性、透明性和隐私问题。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型和多智能体系统在高风险领域需要可靠的验证机制，但集中式审计存在鲁棒性（单点故障）、可扩展性（推理复杂性导致瓶颈）、透明性（隐藏审计侵蚀信任）和隐私性（推理痕迹泄露模型逻辑）四大局限。
AI.method: TRUST框架包含三大创新：(i) 层次化有向无环图(HDAG)将链式推理分解为五个抽象层次，支持并行分布式审计；(ii) DAAN协议将多智能体交互投影为因果交互图(CIG)实现确定性根因归因；(iii) 多层级共识机制在计算检查器、LLM评估器和人类专家之间通过权益加权投票，证明30%节点恶意下仍保证正确性。同时采用隐私保护分割和链上记录。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和基准测试上，TRUST达到72.4%准确率（高出基线4-18%），在20%腐败率下保持韧性。DAAN根因归因达70%（对比标准方法54-63%），节省60%令牌。人类研究验证设计有效（F1=0.89, Brier=0.074）。
AI.conclusion: TRUST框架支持去中心化审计、防篡改排行榜、去信任数据标注和受控自主智能体，为推理能力系统安全、负责任的部署开辟了去中心化AI审计的新路径。

title: Unpacking Vibe Coding: Help-Seeking Processes in Student-AI Interactions While Programming
comment: Accepted by the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED'26)
summary: Generative AI is reshaping higher education programming through vibe coding, where students collaborate with AI via natural language rather than writing code line-by-line. We conceptualize this practice as help-seeking, analyzing 19,418 interaction turns from 110 undergraduate students. Using inductive coding and Heterogeneous Transition Network Analysis, we examined interaction sequences to compare top- and low-performing students. Results reveal that top performers engaged in instrumental help-seeking -- inquiry and exploration -- eliciting tutor-like AI responses. In contrast, low performers relied on executive help-seeking, frequently delegating tasks and prompting the AI to assume an executor role focused on ready-made solutions. These findings indicate that currently generative AI mirrors student intent (whether productive or passive) rather than optimizing for learning. To evolve from tools to teammates, AI systems must move beyond passive compliance. We argue for pedagogically aligned design that detect unproductive delegation and adaptively steer educational interactions toward inquiry, ensuring student-AI partnerships augment rather than replace cognitive effort.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了110名本科生在编程中与生成式AI的19418次交互，发现高分学生倾向于工具性求助（探究性交互），低分学生偏向执行性求助（任务委托），表明当前AI镜像学生意图而非促进学习，需设计能检测非生产性委托并引导探究的教育AI系统。
AI.motivation: 探索生成式AI在高等教育编程中的实际使用模式，特别是不同表现水平的学生如何与AI协作，以及当前AI系统是否真正促进学习。
AI.method: 对110名本科生的19,418次交互进行归纳编码和异质转移网络分析，比较高低表现学生的交互序列模式。
AI.result: 高分学生表现出工具性求助（探究与探索），AI扮演导师角色；低分学生依赖执行性求助（委托任务），AI扮演执行者角色。AI当前镜像学生意图而非优化学习。
AI.conclusion: AI系统需要从被动顺从转向教学对齐的设计，检测非生产性委托并自适应地将交互导向探究，确保学生-AI合作增强而非替代认知努力。

A pedagogical AI system that adaptively steers interactions from executive help-seeking (task delegation) toward instrumental help-seeking (inquiry and exploration) in real-time
A system that classifies AI responses as tutor-like versus executor-like based on interaction sequence analysis, enabling adaptive response modulation

title: Optimal Stop-Loss and Take-Profit Parameterization for Autonomous Trading Agent Swarm
summary: Autonomous crypto trading systems often spend most of their design effort on finding entries, while exits are left to fixed rules that are rarely tested in a systematic way. This paper examines whether better stop-loss and take-profit settings can improve the performance of an autonomous trading agent swarm. Using more than 900 historical trades, we replay each trade under many alternative exit policies and compare results against the existing production setup. The study finds that exit design matters meaningfully: stronger configurations improve risk-adjusted performance and generally favor tighter loss limits, earlier profit capture, and closer trailing protection. The paper also discusses a key evaluation challenge: a purely chronological split was initially used, but the newest trades fell into an unusual war-driven market period that sharply distorted test results. To reduce the influence of that single episode, the main comparison was run on randomized data, with the drawbacks of doing so acknowledged explicitly. Overall, the paper presents a practical framework for tuning exit logic in a more disciplined and transparent way.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了加密自主交易系统中退出策略（止损、止盈、追踪保护）的设计，发现更优的退出设置能显著改善风险调整后收益，偏好更紧的止损、更早的止盈和更近的追踪保护，并讨论了时间序列数据分割与随机化评估的挑战。
AI.motivation: 自主交易系统通常将大量精力用于寻找入场点，而退出策略（止损、止盈）往往被简化为固定规则且缺乏系统性测试，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于900多个历史交易记录，对每笔交易回放多种替代退出策略（不同的止损、止盈、追踪保护设置），并与现有生产环境配置进行对比。由于时间序列数据中存在异常市场时期（战争驱动），主比较在随机化数据上运行。
AI.result: 退出策略设计显著影响系统性能；更优配置提升了风险调整后收益；偏好更紧的止损限制、更早的利润捕获和更近的追踪保护。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个实用框架，用于以更严谨、更透明的方式调整交易系统的退出逻辑。
idea_en: A method for systematically optimizing stop-loss and take-profit exit policies in autonomous trading agents by replaying historical trades under multiple alternative exit configurations and comparing risk-adjusted performance metrics.

A randomized data splitting evaluation framework that reduces the influence of single anomalous market episodes (e.g., war-driven periods) on backtesting results, with explicit acknowledgement of the drawbacks of breaking chronological order.

A trailing protection adjustment technique that tightens the trailing distance dynamically based on market volatility or cumulative profit, improving risk-adjusted returns in autonomous crypto trading swarms.
A disciplined exit logic tuning framework that decouples entry and exit design phases, enabling independent optimization of exit rules without altering the entry strategy.
idea_ch: 一种系统优化自主交易代理止损和止盈退出策略的方法，通过在多种替代退出配置下回放历史交易并比较风险调整后的性能指标。
一种随机化数据分割评估框架，减少单个异常市场时期（如战争驱动时期）对回测结果的影响，同时明确承认打破时间顺序的缺点。
一种基于市场波动性或累计利润动态收紧追踪保护距离的技术，改善自主加密交易集群的风险调整后收益。
一种将入场和退出设计阶段解耦的严谨退出逻辑调整框架，使退出规则的独立优化无需改变入场策略。

title: Step-level Optimization for Efficient Computer-use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents provide a promising path toward general software automation because they can interact directly with arbitrary graphical user interfaces instead of relying on brittle, application-specific integrations. Despite recent advances in benchmark performance, strong computer-use agents remain expensive and slow in practice, since most systems invoke large multimodal models at nearly every interaction step. We argue that this uniform allocation of compute is fundamentally inefficient for long-horizon GUI tasks. Such trajectories are highly heterogeneous: many steps are routine and can be handled reliably by smaller, cheaper policies, while errors tend to concentrate at a relatively small number of high-risk moments. Across computer-use benchmarks, these failures repeatedly take two forms: progress stalls, where the agent loops, repeats ineffective actions, or fails to make meaningful progress, and silent semantic drift, where the agent continues taking locally plausible actions after already deviating from the user's true goal. To address this inefficiency, we propose an event-driven, step-level cascade for computer-use agents that runs a small policy by default and escalates to a stronger model only when lightweight learned monitors detect elevated risk. Our framework combines two complementary signals: a Stuck Monitor that detects degraded progress from recent reasoning-action history and triggers recovery, and a Milestone Monitor that identifies semantically meaningful checkpoints where sparse verification is most informative for catching drift. This design turns always-on frontier-model inference into adaptive, on-demand compute allocation over the course of an evolving interaction. The framework is modular and deployment-oriented: it can be layered on top of existing computer-use agents without changing the underlying agent architecture or retraining the large model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种事件驱动的、步骤级联的计算机使用智能体框架，通过轻量级监控器（Stuck Monitor和Milestone Monitor）检测高风险时刻，默认用小模型执行，仅在必要时升级到大模型，从而降低长程GUI任务的成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体在每次交互步骤中都调用大型多模态模型，导致成本高昂且速度缓慢。长程GUI任务具有高度异质性——多数步骤是常规操作，错误集中在少数高风险时刻，而当前系统对所有步骤均匀分配计算资源，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出事件驱动的步骤级联框架：（1）默认使用小型、低成本策略处理常规步骤；（2）Stuck Monitor检测进度停滞（循环、重复无效动作等）并触发恢复；（3）Milestone Monitor识别语义上有意义的检查点，在漂移发生时进行稀疏验证；（4）仅当轻量级监控器检测到高风险时，才升级到更强的大模型。
AI.result: 该框架能够将始终在线的前沿模型推理转变为自适应的按需计算分配，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算成本和延迟。模块化设计可叠加在现有智能体之上，无需改变底层架构或重新训练大模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级监控器识别高风险时刻并动态分配计算资源，可以有效解决计算机使用智能体在长程任务中的效率瓶颈，为实用化部署提供了可行路径。
idea_en: Event-driven step-level cascade framework for computer-use agents that runs a small policy by default and escalates to a stronger model only when lightweight learned monitors detect elevated risk
Stuck Monitor that detects degraded progress from recent reasoning-action history in GUI automation and triggers recovery mechanisms
Milestone Monitor that identifies semantically meaningful checkpoints in GUI task trajectories where sparse verification is most informative for catching silent semantic drift
Dual-monitor system combining progress stall detection and semantic drift detection for adaptive compute allocation in long-horizon GUI tasks
Modular deployment-oriented framework that can be layered on top of existing computer-use agents without changing underlying agent architecture or retraining large models
idea_ch: 事件驱动的步骤级联框架：计算机使用智能体默认使用小模型执行常规步骤，仅当轻量级监控器检测到高风险时才升级到大模型，实现自适应计算分配

title: Interval Orders, Biorders and Credibility-limited Belief Revision
summary: Rational belief revision is commonly viewed as being based on a preference order between possible worlds, with the resulting new belief set being those sentences true in all the most preferred models of the incoming new information. Usually, such a preference order is taken to be a total preorder. Nevertheless, there are other, more general classes of ordering that can also be employed. In this paper, we explore two such classes that have been studied within the theory of rational choice but have seen limited or no application in belief revision. We begin with interval orders, introduced by Fishburn in the '80s, which associate with each possible world a nonnegative `interval' of plausibility. We then move on to biorders, studied by Aleskerov, Bouyssou, and Monjardet, which generalise interval orders by allowing the intervals to have negative lengths, a feature that can be used to capture a notion of dissonance or instability. We provide axiomatic characterisations of these two resulting families of belief revision operators, as well as of two further families of interest that lie between interval orders and biorders. We show that while biorder-based revisions satisfy the Success postulate, they do not always yield consistent outputs. By modifying their definition to discard inputs that lead to inconsistency as `incredible', we derive new families of so-called non-prioritised revision that satisfy the Consistency postulate, but not the Success one. These families are linked to credibility-limited revision operators of Hansson et al., but for which the set of credible sentences does not satisfy the single-sentence closure condition. We argue that the biorder-based approach is well-suited for scenarios where an agent might initially reject new information, but may accept it when presented with additional explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了基于区间序和双序两种广义偏好序的信念修正算子，提出了四类新的修正算子家族，并给出了公理化刻画。其中基于双序的修正可产生非优先修正，适用于代理可能拒绝新信息但在额外解释下可接受的情境。
AI.motivation: 传统信念修正基于全预序，但更广义的序关系在理性选择理论中已有研究却鲜少应用于信念修正。本文旨在探索区间序和双序这两类更一般的序在信念修正中的适用性。
AI.method: 将区间序和双序引入信念修正框架，定义基于这些序的修正算子，给出公理化特征刻画，并研究其满足成功公设、一致性公设等基本性质的情况。
AI.result: 得到了四类新的修正算子家族（区间序修正、双序修正及介于其间的两类修正），揭示了双序修正不总满足一致性，但通过修改定义（丢弃导致不一致的输入为"不可信"）可得到满足一致性但不满足成功公设的非优先修正家族。
AI.conclusion: 基于双序的方法适用于代理可能先拒绝新信息、但在额外解释后能接受的情境，拓展了信念修正的理论框架。
idea_en: A belief revision method using interval orders, where each possible world is assigned a plausibility interval instead of a single preference rank, enabling more nuanced uncertainty representation.
A belief revision operator based on biorders that allows intervals with negative lengths to capture dissonance or instability in belief states.
A non-prioritized belief revision family derived from biorders that discards inputs leading to inconsistency as 'incredible', satisfying Consistency but not Success postulate.
A credibility-limited revision system where the set of credible sentences does not require single-sentence closure, enabling flexible acceptance of new information with additional explanation.
A family of belief revision operators lying between interval orders and biorders, providing intermediate levels of representational power for preference ordering.
idea_ch: 一种使用区间序的信念修正方法，为每个可能世界分配一个可信度区间而非单一偏好秩，实现更精细的不确定性表征。
基于双序的信念修正算子，允许区间具有负长度以捕获信念状态中的不和谐或不稳定性。
从双序导出的非优先修正家族，将导致不一致的输入视为'不可信'并丢弃，满足一致性公设但不满足成功公设。
一种可信度受限的修正系统，其中可信句子的集合不需要满足单句封闭条件，允许在额外解释下灵活接受新信息。
位于区间序和双序之间的信念修正算子家族，提供中间级别的偏好排序表征能力。

title: Evaluating TabPFN for Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Conversion in Data Limited Settings
summary: Accurate prediction of conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimers Diseases (AD) is essential for early intervention, however, developing reliable conversion predictive models is difficult to develop due to limited longitudinal data availability We evaluate TabPFN (Tabular Pre-Trained Foundation Network) against traditional machine learning methods for predicting 3 year MCI to AD conversion using the TADPOLE dataset derived from ADNI. Using multimodal biomarker features extracted from demographics, APOE4, MRI volumes, CSF markers, and PET imaging, we conducted an experimental comparison across varying training set sizes (N=50 to 1000) and models including XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM, and Logistic Regression. TabPFN achieved one the highest performance (AUC=0.892), outperforming LightGBM (AUC=0.860) and demonstrating advantages in low data settings. At N=50 training samples, TabPFN maintained strong AUC while the traditional machine learning models struggles at small training samples. These findings demonstrate that foundation models are promising for disease prediction in data limited scenarios, such as Alzheimers diseases.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了TabPFN（表格预训练基础网络）在预测轻度认知障碍（MCI）向阿尔茨海默病（AD）三年期转化中的性能，发现其在有限数据场景下优于传统机器学习方法，AUC达到0.892。
AI.motivation: 准确预测MCI向AD的转化对于早期干预至关重要，但由于纵向数据有限，开发可靠的预测模型面临挑战。本文旨在探索基础模型在数据稀缺场景下的应用潜力。
AI.method: 使用TADPOLE数据集（源自ADNI），提取多模态生物标志物特征（包括人口统计学、APOE4、MRI体积、CSF标志物和PET成像），在不同训练集大小（N=50至1000）下，将TabPFN与XGBoost、随机森林、LightGBM和逻辑回归等传统机器学习方法进行对比实验。
AI.result: TabPFN取得了最高性能（AUC=0.892），优于LightGBM（AUC=0.860）。在仅有50个训练样本的低数据场景下，TabPFN仍保持较强性能，而传统机器学习模型则表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在数据有限的疾病预测场景中具有显著优势，为阿尔茨海默病的早期预测提供了新途径。
idea_en: A method for predicting MCI-to-AD conversion using a pre-trained tabular foundation network (TabPFN) that maintains high accuracy even with limited training samples (N=50).

A multimodal biomarker fusion framework combining demographics, APOE4, MRI volumes, CSF markers, and PET imaging data for input to a pre-trained tabular foundation model for disease conversion prediction.
A low-data regime disease prediction system leveraging TabPFN that outperforms traditional ensemble methods (XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM) when training samples are scarce.
A time-constrained (3-year) MCI-to-AD conversion prediction approach using TabPFN that achieves AUC of 0.892 without requiring extensive longitudinal training data.
idea_ch: 一种使用预训练表格基础网络（TabPFN）预测MCI向AD转化的方法，即使在有限训练样本（N=50）下仍能保持高准确率。
一种多模态生物标志物融合框架，将人口统计学、APOE4、MRI体积、CSF标志物和PET成像数据整合后输入预训练表格基础模型，用于疾病转化预测。
一种低数据场景下的疾病预测系统，利用TabPFN在训练样本稀缺时优于传统集成方法（XGBoost、随机森林、LightGBM）的性能优势。
一种基于TabPFN的三年期MCI-to-AD转化预测方法，无需大量纵向训练数据即可实现AUC=0.892的预测性能。

title: Toward Personalized Digital Twins for Cognitive Decline Assessment: A Multimodal, Uncertainty-Aware Framework
summary: Cognitive decline is highly heterogeneous across individuals, which complicates prognosis, trial design, and treatment planning. We present the Personalized Cognitive Decline Assessment Digital Twin (PCD-DT), a multimodal and uncertainty-aware framework for modeling patient-specific disease trajectories from sparse, noisy, and irregular longitudinal data. The framework combines three methodological components: (1) latent state-space models for individualized temporal dynamics, (2) multimodal fusion for clinical, biomarker, and imaging features, and (3) uncertainty-aware validation and adaptive updating for robust digital twin operation. We also outline how conditional generative models can support data augmentation and stress testing for underrepresented progression patterns. As a preliminary feasibility study, we analyze longitudinal TADPOLE trajectories and show clear separation between cognitively normal and Alzheimer's disease cohorts in ADAS13, ventricle volume, and hippocampal volume over five years. We further conduct a multimodal next-visit prediction ablation using an LSTM sequence model on 3{,}003 visit-pair sequences derived from TADPOLE, where the combined cognitive plus MRI configuration achieves the lowest standardized RMSE for both ADAS13 (0.4419) and ventricle volume (0.5842), outperforming a Last Observation Carried Forward baseline. A Bayesian tensor modeling component for high-dimensional imaging fusion is also discussed. These results support the feasibility of the proposed architecture while also highlighting the need for stronger uncertainty calibration and longer-horizon predictive evaluation. The PCD-DT framework provides a principled starting point for personalized in silico modeling in neurodegenerative disease. This work positions PCD-DT as a foundational step toward clinically deployable, uncertainty-aware digital twin systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种个性化认知衰退评估数字孪生框架(PCD-DT)，结合潜在状态空间模型、多模态融合与不确定性感知验证，用于从稀疏、不规则的纵向数据中建模患者特异性疾病轨迹，初步实验在TADPOLE数据集上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 认知衰退在个体间高度异质，现有方法难以从稀疏、不规则、含噪声的纵向数据中准确建模个体化疾病轨迹，影响预后判断、试验设计和治疗方案制定。
AI.method: PCD-DT框架包含三个核心组件：(1)潜在状态空间模型用于个体化时间动态建模；(2)多模态融合整合临床、生物标志物和影像特征；(3)不确定性感知验证与自适应更新。此外采用条件生成模型进行数据增强，并使用LSTM序列模型进行多模态下次访问预测消融实验。
AI.result: 在TADPOLE数据集上，认知正常与AD队列在ADAS13、脑室体积和海马体积上呈现清晰分离；认知+MRI配置的LSTM模型在ADAS13（0.4419）和脑室体积（0.5842）上取得最低标准化RMSE，优于Last Observation Carried Forward基线。
AI.conclusion: PCD-DT框架为个性化神经退行性疾病计算机模拟建模提供了原则性起点，但需要更强的不确定性校准和更长预测期评估，是迈向临床可部署的不确定性感知数字孪生系统的基础性步骤。
idea_en: A multimodal digital twin framework combining latent state-space models with uncertainty-aware validation for personalized cognitive decline trajectory prediction from sparse longitudinal data.
Conditional generative models for data augmentation and stress testing of underrepresented cognitive decline progression patterns in Alzheimer's disease.
A Bayesian tensor modeling component for high-dimensional imaging feature fusion within a personalized digital twin architecture.
An adaptive updating mechanism for digital twin operation that incorporates uncertainty calibration from multimodal clinical, biomarker, and imaging data.
LSTM-based multimodal next-visit prediction system combining cognitive scores and MRI features for Alzheimer's disease progression forecasting.
idea_ch: 基于潜在状态空间模型与不确定性感知验证的多模态数字孪生框架，用于从稀疏纵向数据预测个性化认知衰退轨迹
利用条件生成模型对阿尔茨海默病中代表性不足的认知衰退模式进行数据增强和压力测试的方法
面向高维影像特征融合的贝叶斯张量建模组件，集成于个性化数字孪生架构中

title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
summary: Agentic web search increasingly faces two distinct demands: deep reasoning over a single target, and structured aggregation across many entities and heterogeneous sources. Current systems struggle on both fronts. Breadth-oriented tasks demand schema-aligned outputs with wide coverage and cross-entity consistency, while depth-oriented tasks require coherent reasoning over long, branching search trajectories. We introduce \textbf{Web2BigTable}, a multi-agent framework for web-to-table search that supports both regimes. Web2BigTable adopts a bi-level architecture in which an upper-level orchestrator decomposes the task into sub-problems and lower-level worker agents solve them in parallel. Through a closed-loop run--verify--reflect process, the framework jointly improves decomposition and execution over time via persistent, human-readable external memory, with self-evolving updates to each single-agent. During execution, workers coordinate through a shared workspace that makes partial findings visible, allowing them to reduce redundant exploration, reconcile conflicting evidence, and adapt to emerging coverage gaps. Web2BigTable sets a new state of the art on WideSearch, reaching an Avg@4 Success Rate of \textbf{38.50} ($7.5\times$ the second best at 5.10), Row F1 of \textbf{63.53} (+25.03 over the second best), and Item F1 of \textbf{80.12} (+14.42 over the second best). It also generalises to depth-oriented search on XBench-DeepSearch, achieving 73.0 accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/web2bigtable/web2bigtable.

AI.tldr: Web2BigTable是一个多智能体框架，通过双层架构（上层协调器+下层工作智能体）和闭环"运行-验证-反思"流程，同时支持广度导向和深度导向的网络到表格搜索任务，在WideSearch上取得SOTA性能（Avg@4 Success Rate 38.50，是第二名5.10的7.5倍），并在XBench-DeepSearch上达到73.0准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前代理式网络搜索面临广度任务（需跨实体、异构源的架构化聚合）和深度任务（需对长分支搜索轨迹进行连贯推理）的双重挑战，现有系统难以同时兼顾两者。
AI.method: 采用双层架构：上层协调器将任务分解为子问题，下层工作智能体并行执行；通过闭环"运行-验证-反思"流程，利用持久化、人类可读的外部记忆实现自我演化更新；工作智能体通过共享工作区协调，减少冗余探索、调和冲突证据、适应覆盖缺口。
AI.result: 在WideSearch上：Avg@4 Success Rate达38.50（第二名5.10的7.5倍），Row F1达63.53（+25.03），Item F1达80.12（+14.42）；在XBench-DeepSearch上深度任务准确率73.0。
AI.conclusion: Web2BigTable通过双层架构和闭环自我演化机制，有效统一了广度与深度网络搜索任务，实现了跨实体一致性和深度推理能力的双重突破。
idea_en: 1. A bi-level multi-agent architecture for web-to-table search with an upper-level orchestrator decomposing tasks into sub-problems and lower-level worker agents executing in parallel.
2. A closed-loop run-verify-reflect process that jointly improves task decomposition and execution via persistent, human-readable external memory with self-evolving updates.

3. A shared workspace mechanism for worker agents that enables visibility of partial findings, reducing redundant exploration, reconciling conflicting evidence, and adapting to emerging coverage gaps in real-time.
idea_ch: 1. 一种双层多智能体网络到表格搜索架构：上层协调器将任务分解为子问题，下层工作智能体并行执行，实现广度任务的结构化聚合。
2. 闭环'运行-验证-反思'流程：通过持久化、人类可读的外部记忆实现任务分解与执行的联合优化，并支持智能体自我演化更新。
3. 共享工作区协调机制：工作智能体之间实时共享部分发现结果，减少冗余探索、调和冲突证据、动态适应覆盖缺口。

title: When Roles Fail: Epistemic Constraints on Advocate Role Fidelity in LLM-Based Political Statement Analysis
summary: Democratic discourse analysis systems increasingly rely on multi-agent LLM pipelines in which distinct evaluator models are assigned adversarial roles to generate structured, multi-perspective assessments of political statements. A core assumption is that models will reliably maintain their assigned roles. This paper provides the first systematic empirical test of that assumption using the TRUST pipeline. We develop an epistemic stance classifier that identifies advocate roles from reasoning text without relying on surface vocabulary, and measure role fidelity across 60 political statements (30 English, 30 German) using four metrics: Role Drift Index (RDI), Expected Drift Distance (EDD), Directional Drift Index (DDI), and Entropy-based Role Stability (ERS). We identify two failure modes - the Epistemic Floor Effect (fact-check results create an absolute lower bound below which the legitimizing role cannot be maintained) and Role-Prior Conflict (training-time knowledge overrides role instructions for factually unambiguous statements) - as manifestations of a single mechanism: Epistemic Role Override (ERO). Model choice significantly affects role fidelity: Mistral Large outperforms Claude Sonnet by 28pp (67% vs. 39%) and exhibits a qualitatively different failure mode - role abandonment without polarity reversal - compared to Claude's active switch to the opposing stance. Role fidelity is language-robust. Fact-check provider choice is not universally neutral: Perplexity significantly reduces Claude's role fidelity on German statements (Delta = -15pp, p = 0.007) while leaving Mistral unaffected. These findings have direct implications for multi-agent LLM validation: a system validated without role fidelity measurement may systematically misrepresent the epistemic diversity it was designed to provide.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统检验了多智能体LLM管道中角色保真度的假设，发现AI模型在辩论任务中经常偏离其指定角色，识别出"认知下限效应"和"角色-先验冲突"两种失败模式，表明未进行角色保真度验证的系统可能系统性歪曲其本应提供的认知多样性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM管道越来越多地被用于民主话语分析，关键假设是不同模型能可靠地维持其被分配的角色（如正方/反方），但这一假设从未被系统检验过。
AI.method: 开发了认知立场分类器，通过推理文本而非表面词汇识别角色立场；使用TRUST管道测试60条政治声明（30英/30德），采用RDI、EDD、DDI、ERS四个指标测量角色保真度。
AI.result: 识别出两种失败模式：Epistemic Floor Effect（事实核查结果使合法化角色无法维持）和Role-Prior Conflict（训练知识覆盖角色指令）；Mistral Large表现优于Claude Sonnet（67% vs 39%）；角色保真度具有语言鲁棒性；Perplexity显著降低Claude在德语上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 角色保真度是多智能体LLM验证的关键维度，缺乏该验证的系统可能系统性歪曲其本应提供的认知多样性，对民主话语分析系统有直接启示。
idea_en: Epistemic Stance Classifier: A method for identifying advocate roles from reasoning text without relying on surface vocabulary, enabling role fidelity measurement in multi-agent LLM systems.
Role Drift Index (RDI): A quantitative metric for measuring the degree to which an LLM deviates from its assigned adversarial role in multi-agent discourse systems.
Expected Drift Distance (EDD): A metric that computes the expected distance between a model's expressed stance and its assigned role across multiple reasoning instances.
Directional Drift Index (DDI): A metric designed to detect polarity reversal in role-assigned LLMs, distinguishing between passive role abandonment and active stance switching.
Entropy-based Role Stability (ERS): A metric using entropy to quantify the stability and consistency of role maintenance in multi-LLM dialogue systems.
Epistemic Role Override (ERO) detection mechanism: A method for identifying when fact-check results or training-prior knowledge cause an LLM to override its assigned role instructions.
Cross-language role fidelity benchmarking: A system and method for evaluating LLM role maintenance capabilities across multiple languages to ensure language-robust democratic discourse analysis.
idea_ch: 认知立场分类器：一种通过推理文本而非表面词汇识别倡导者角色的方法，用于多智能体LLM系统中的角色保真度测量
角色漂移指数（RDI）：量化LLM在多智能体话语系统中偏离其分配角色的程度的度量指标
预期漂移距离（EDD）：计算模型在多次推理中表达的立场与分配角色之间预期差异的度量方法
方向性漂移指数（DDI）：检测角色分配LLM中极性反转的指标，能够区分被动角色放弃与主动立场切换
基于熵的角色稳定性（ERS）：利用熵量化多LLM对话系统中角色维持稳定性和一致性的度量方法
认知角色覆盖（ERO）检测机制：识别事实核查结果或训练先验知识导致LLM覆盖其分配角色指令的方法

title: Reinforced Agent: Inference-Time Feedback for Tool-Calling Agents
summary:
Tool-calling agents are evaluated on tool selection, parameter accuracy, and scope recognition, yet LLM trajectory assessments remain inherently post-hoc. Disconnected from the active execution loop, such assessments identify errors that are usually addressed through prompt-tuning or retraining, and fundamentally cannot course-correct the agent in real time. To close this gap, we move evaluation into the execution loop at inference time: a specialized reviewer agent evaluates provisional tool calls prior to execution, shifting the paradigm from post-hoc recovery to proactive evaluation and error mitigation.
  In practice, this architecture establishes a clear separation of concerns between the primary execution agent and a secondary review agent. As with any multi-agent system, the reviewer can introduce new errors while correcting others, yet no prior work to our knowledge has systematically measured this tradeoff. To quantify this tradeoff, we introduce Helpfulness-Harmfulness metrics: helpfulness measures the percentage of base agent errors that feedback corrects; harmfulness measures the percentage of correct responses that feedback degrades. These metrics directly inform reviewer design by revealing whether a given model or prompt provides net positive value.
  We evaluate our approach on BFCL (single-turn) and Tau2-Bench (multi-turn stateful scenarios), achieving +5.5% on irrelevance detection and +7.1% on multi-turn tasks. Our metrics reveal that reviewer model choice is critical: the reasoning model o3-mini achieves a 3:1 benefit-to-risk ratio versus 2.1:1 for GPT-4o. Automated prompt optimization via GEPA provides an additional +1.5-2.8%. Together, these results demonstrate a core advantage of separating execution and review: the reviewer can be systematically improved through model selection and prompt optimization, without retraining the base agent.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在推理时将评估嵌入执行循环的审稿智能体架构，通过分离执行与审查职责，实现工具调用错误的实时纠正，并引入Helpfulness-Harmfulness指标量化审查带来的收益与风险。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM轨迹评估是事后(post-hoc)的，脱离执行循环，只能通过提示调优或重新训练来修复错误，无法实时纠正智能体行为。
AI.method: 在推理时将评估嵌入执行循环，由一个专门的审稿智能体(Reviewer Agent)在执行前评估主智能体(Execution Agent)的临时工具调用，形成执行-审查分离的双智能体架构；并设计Helpfulness-Harmfulness指标量化审查的净收益。
AI.result: 在BFCL上不相关检测提升+5.5%，在Tau2-Bench多轮任务上提升+7.1%；o3-mini的收益风险比3:1优于GPT-4o的2.1:1；GEPA自动提示优化额外提升+1.5-2.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将执行与审查分离的核心优势在于：审稿智能体可通过模型选择和提示优化系统性改进，而无需重新训练基础智能体。
idea_en: A dual-agent architecture for tool-calling agents where a reviewer agent evaluates provisional tool calls at inference time before execution, enabling real-time error correction within the execution loop.

Helpfulness-Harmfulness metrics that quantify the tradeoff of multi-agent reviewer systems by measuring both the percentage of base agent errors corrected (helpfulness) and the percentage of correct responses degraded (harmfulness).
A method for automated prompt optimization (GEPA) specifically targeting the reviewer agent to improve its error correction performance without retraining the base execution agent.

A separation-of-concerns framework for tool-calling systems where the execution agent and review agent use different models (e.g., o3-mini for review, GPT-4o for execution) to optimize overall system performance.
idea_ch: 一种用于工具调用智能体的双智能体架构，在执行前由审稿智能体在推理时评估临时工具调用，实现执行循环内的实时错误纠正
Helpfulness-Harmfulness指标，通过测量被纠正的基础智能体错误百分比(有益性)和被降级的正确响应百分比(有害性)，量化多智能体审稿系统的收益-风险权衡
一种针对审稿智能体的自动提示优化方法(GEPA)，在不重新训练基础执行智能体的情况下提升纠错性能
工具调用系统中的职责分离框架，执行智能体和审稿智能体使用不同模型(如o3-mini用于审查，GPT-4o用于执行)，以优化整体系统性能

title: AutoSurfer -- Teaching Web Agents through Comprehensive Surfing, Learning, and Modeling
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized web agents that can automate complex tasks on websites. However, their accuracy remains limited by the scarcity of high-quality web trajectory training data. Existing automatic trajectory generation methods suffer from incomplete website coverage due to homepage-based task proposals or random-walk exploration. Such methods often result in hallucinated or ambiguous task synthesis that lead to incomplete and unreliable trajectory generation. Here, we present AutoSurfer, a comprehensive web trajectory generator that addresses these limitations through three key innovations. First, AutoSurfer employs a systematic breadth-first exploration strategy that maintains a queue of discovered pages and action traces, propagates knowledge across pages to avoid redundant exploration, and recursively expands multi-level graphical user interface elements - closely resembling how a human would learn a new website. Second, AutoSurfer leverages the exploration trajectory to guide task synthesis, reducing hallucinations by grounding complex tasks in actual navigation paths rather than isolated actions or page content alone. Third, AutoSurfer uses the same exploration trajectory as hints to steer a web agent toward more accurate and reliable trajectory refinement. Together, these innovations enable AutoSurfer to comprehensively cover a website's action space and generate data suitable for training website-specific LLMs. We evaluate AutoSurfer on the WebArena benchmark by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and demonstrate that it outperforms state-of-the-art methods - Explorer, OS-Genesis, and SynthAgent - achieving up to 24.23% overall task completion accuracy compared to 19.59% for the best prior method. Further, task diversity analysis demonstrates that AutoSurfer yields a more diverse distribution of synthesized tasks.

AI.tldr: AutoSurfer是一种新颖的Web轨迹生成器，通过广度优先探索策略、基于探索轨迹引导任务合成以及利用轨迹作为提示进行轨迹精炼三大创新，大幅提升了Web代理的自动化任务完成精度。在WebArena基准上，其微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型达到24.23%的任务完成准确率，超越此前最优方法（19.59%）。
AI.motivation: 现有Web代理因高质量Web轨迹训练数据稀缺而精度受限。现有的自动轨迹生成方法存在网站覆盖不全（基于首页任务提议或随机游走探索）、任务合成产生幻觉或歧义导致轨迹不可靠等问题。
AI.method: 1) 系统性广度优先探索策略：维护已发现页面和操作轨迹的队列，跨页面传播知识避免冗余探索，递归展开多层GUI元素；2) 基于探索轨迹的任务合成：将复杂任务锚定在真实导航路径上，减少幻觉；3) 利用探索轨迹作为提示引导Web代理进行更准确可靠的轨迹精炼。
AI.result: 在WebArena基准上，微调Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型，AutoSurfer达到24.23%的任务完成准确率，超越Explorer、OS-Genesis和SynthAgent等最先进方法（最优对比方法为19.59%）。任务多样性分析表明AutoSurfer合成的任务分布更丰富多样。
AI.conclusion: AutoSurfer通过系统性探索策略和轨迹引导方法，实现了网站动作空间的全面覆盖，能生成高质量的训练数据，显著提升了Web代理的任务完成精度。
idea_en: Systematic breadth-first exploration method for web agents that maintains a queue of discovered pages and action traces, propagates knowledge across pages to avoid redundant exploration, and recursively expands multi-level GUI elements to achieve comprehensive website coverage.

Exploration-trajectory-guided task synthesis method that grounds complex tasks in actual navigation paths rather than isolated actions or page content, reducing hallucinated or ambiguous task generation.
Exploration-trajectory-as-hint trajectory refinement technique that uses the same exploration trajectory as prompts to guide a web agent toward more accurate and reliable trajectory completion.
Queue-based page discovery and action trace propagation mechanism that enables knowledge transfer across different pages of a website to prevent redundant exploration.
idea_ch: 一种系统性广度优先探索方法，维护已发现页面及操作轨迹的队列，跨页面传播知识避免冗余探索，递归展开多层GUI元素以实现网站动作空间全面覆盖
基于探索轨迹引导的任务合成方法，将复杂任务锚定在真实导航路径上，而非孤立的动作或页面内容，减少幻觉化或歧义性任务生成
探索轨迹作为提示的轨迹精炼技术，利用相同的探索轨迹作为提示引导Web代理完成更准确可靠的轨迹执行
基于队列的页面发现与操作轨迹传播机制，实现网站不同页面间的知识迁移，防止冗余探索

title: OptimusKG: Unifying biomedical knowledge in a modern multimodal graph
summary: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) are widely used in the life sciences, yet many are derived from unstructured documents and therefore lack schema-level constrains, whereas graphs assembled from structured resources are difficult to harmonize into a unified representation. We present OptimusKG, a multimodal biomedical labeled property graph (LPG) built from structured and semi-structured resources to preserve factual, type-specific metadata across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. OptimusKG contains 190,531 nodes across 10 entity types, 21,813,816 edges across 26 relation types, and 67,249,863 property instances encoding 110,276,843 values across 150 distinct property keys, derived from 18 ontologies and controlled vocabularies. The graph enforces a top-level schema for nodes and edges and retains granular, type-specific properties, cross-references, and provenance across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. We assessed the validity of OptimusKG by evaluating whether graph relationships are supported by evidence from the scientific literature using a multimodal agent, PaperQA3. PaperQA3 identified supporting evidence for 70.0% of sampled edges, whereas 83.4% of sampled false edges received no supporting evidence. Edges without literature support were concentrated in associations derived from experimental and functional genomics resources, suggesting that OptimusKG captures biomedical knowledge that may precede synthesis in the scientific literature. OptimusKG is distributed as Apache Parquet files, providing a standardized resource for graph-based machine learning, knowledge-grounded retrieval with large language models, and biomedical discovery use cases such as hypothesis generation.

AI.tldr: OptimusKG是一个多模态生物医学标记属性图，整合了18个本体和受控词汇表的结构化与半结构化资源，包含190,531个节点、21,813,816条边和67,249,863个属性实例，支持图机器学习、大语言模型知识检索和假设生成等应用。
AI.motivation: 现有的生物医学知识图谱要么来自非结构化文档缺乏模式约束，要么来自结构化资源难以统一表示，缺乏同时具备模式约束和多领域跨引用信息的高质量图谱。
AI.method: 从18个本体和受控词汇表中提取结构化与半结构化数据，构建为标记属性图（LPG），强制顶层节点和边的模式，同时保留细粒度、类型特定的属性、交叉引用和来源信息。使用多模态智能体PaperQA3评估图关系是否得到科学文献支持。
AI.result: 70.0%的采样边获得文献支持，83.4%的假边未获得支持。缺乏文献支持的边主要集中在实验和功能基因组学资源衍生的关联，表明OptimusKG可能捕获了尚未在文献中综合的生物医学知识。

title: The Inverse-Wisdom Law: Architectural Tribalism and the Consensus Paradox in Agentic Swarms
summary: As AI transitions toward multi-agent systems (MAS) to solve complex workflows, research paradigms operate on the axiomatic assumption that agent collaboration mirrors the "Wisdom of the Crowd". We challenge this assumption by formalizing the Consensus Paradox: a phenomenon where agentic swarms prioritize internal architectural agreement over external logical truth. Through a 36 experiments encompassing 12,804 trajectories across three state-of-the-art (SOTA) benchmarks (GAIA, Multi-Challenge, and SWE-bench), we prove the Inverse-Wisdom Law: in kinship-dominant swarms, adding logical agents increases the stability of erroneous trajectories rather than the probability of truth. The introduction of additional logical audits converges the system toward a Logic Saturation where internal entropy hits zero while factual error hits unity. By evaluating the interaction between the 3 preeminent SOTA models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.4), we establish the Architectural Tribalism Asymmetry as a mechanistic law of transformer weights. We demonstrate that terminal swarm integrity is strictly gated by the synthesizer's receptive logic, rather than aggregate agent quality. We define the Tribalism Coefficient and the Sycophantic Weight as the primary mechanistic determinants of swarm failure. Finally, we establish the Heterogeneity Mandate as a foundational safety requirement for resilient agentic architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了多智能体系统中"群体智慧"的假设，通过大量实验发现了"共识悖论"现象，证明同质化智能体群体倾向于追求内部共识而非外部真理，并提出了相关理论与安全要求。
AI.motivation: 挑战多智能体系统（MAS）中"群体智慧"这一未经检验的基本假设，揭示智能体协作可能因内部架构共识而偏离逻辑真理的现象。
AI.method: 在GAIA、Multi-Challenge和SWE-bench三个SOTA基准上，设计36组实验，涵盖12,804条轨迹，评估Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-5.4三种前沿模型在亲缘主导型智能体群体中的协作行为。
AI.result: 发现逆向智慧定律：在同质化亲缘型群体中，增加逻辑智能体会增强错误轨迹的稳定性而非真理概率；逻辑审计达到"逻辑饱和"后，内部熵为零而事实错误率为1；终端群体完整性严格受限于合成器的接收逻辑而非聚合智能体质量。
AI.conclusion: 提出了部落系数和谄媚权重作为群体失效的主要机制决定因素，并建立了异质性强制要求作为弹性智能体架构的基础安全需求。

System for quantifying Inverse-Wisdom Law through measurement of trajectory stability vs. logical agent count
Architecture with Heterogeneity Mandate enforcement mechanism to prevent Logic Saturation in agent swarms
Method for measuring Tribalism Coefficient and Sycophantic Weight as predictive indicators of swarm failure

title: Mechanized Foundations of Structural Governance: Machine-Checked Proofs for Governed Intelligence
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Code and proofs: https://github.com/mashin-live/governance-proofs
summary: We present five results in the theory of structural governance for cognitive workflow systems. Three are mechanized in Coq 8.19 using the Interaction Trees library with parameterized coinduction; two are proved on paper with explicit reductions. The Coinductive Safety Predicate (gov_safe) is a coinductive property that captures governance safety for infinite program behaviors, indexed by a boolean permission flag that is provably false for ungoverned I/O and true for governed interpretations (mechanized). The Governance Invariance Theorem establishes that governance is uniform across the meta-recursive tower: governance at level n+1 reduces to governance at level n by definitional equality of the type (mechanized). The Sufficiency Theorem proves that four atomic primitives (code, reason, memory, call) are expressively complete for any discrete intelligent system, formalized as compositional closure of a Kleisli category (mechanized). The Alternating Normal Form provides a canonical decomposition of any machine into alternating code and effect layers, with a confluent rewriting system (paper proof). The Necessity Theorem proves via explicit reduction to Rice's theorem that an architecturally opaque component (the reason primitive) is mathematically necessary for problems requiring semantic judgment (paper proof). A sixth contribution connects the abstract model to the deployed runtime: the Verified Interpreter Specification formalizes the BEAM runtime's trust, capability, and hash chain logic in Coq, then tests the running system against this specification using property-based testing with over 70,000 randomly generated directive sequences and zero disagreements. The mechanization comprises approximately 12,000 lines across 36 modules with 454 theorems and zero admitted lemmas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构治理理论框架，涵盖五条核心定理（含三条Coq机械化证明、两条纸面归约证明）及一个运行时验证贡献，证明治理安全性、不变性、充分性、规范分解及必要性的数学基础，并通过12,000行Coq代码与70,000+随机测试验证BEAM运行时。
AI.motivation: 为了给认知工作流系统建立严格的、可机械化验证的治理（Governance）理论基础，证明治理在无限程序行为、元递归层级、原子原语表达力等方面的数学性质，并连接到实际运行时系统。
AI.method: 采用交互树（Interaction Trees）库与参数化共归纳（parameterized coinduction）在Coq 8.19中机械化证明治理安全性、不变性、充分性定理；对交替范式与必要性定理采用纸面显式规约证明；通过基于属性的随机测试（70,000+序列）验证BEAM运行时与Coq规格的一致性。
AI.result: 机械化证明了三项核心定理，纸面证明了两项定理；系统通过了70,000+随机生成的指令序列测试且零分歧；Coq形式化包含约12,000行代码、36个模块、454个定理、零个未完成引理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为认知工作流系统的治理提供了严密的理论基础，包括形式化安全谓词、层级不变性、原子原语完备性、规范分解及必要性证明，并通过机械化验证确保理论与运行时的一致性。

Governance Invariance Theorem establishing uniform governance across meta-recursive tower via definitional equality.
Sufficiency Theorem proving four atomic primitives (code, reason, memory, call) are expressively complete for any discrete intelligent system via Kleisli category closure.
Alternating Normal Form providing canonical decomposition of machines into alternating code and effect layers with confluent rewriting system.
Necessity Theorem proving the reason primitive is mathematically necessary for semantic judgment problems via reduction to Rice's theorem.
Verified Interpreter Specification formalizing BEAM runtime's trust, capability, and hash chain logic in Coq with property-based testing verification.

title: The Two Boundaries: Why Behavioral AI Governance Fails Structurally
summary: Every system that performs effects has two boundaries: what it can do (expressiveness) and what governance covers (governance). In nearly all deployed AI systems, these boundaries are defined independently, creating three regions: governed capabilities (the only useful region), ungoverned capabilities (risk), and governance policies that address non-existent capabilities (theater). Two of the three regions are failure modes. We focus on the governance of effects: actions that AI systems perform in the world (API calls, database writes, tool invocations). This is distinct from the governance of model outputs (content quality, bias, fairness), which operates at a different level and requires different mechanisms. We present a formal framework for analyzing this structural gap. Rice's theorem (1953) proves the gap is undecidable in the general case for any Turing-complete architecture that attempts to govern effects behaviorally: no algorithm can decide non-trivial semantic properties of arbitrary programs, including the property "this program's effects comply with the governance policy." We define coterminous governance: a system property where the expressivenessboundary equals the governance boundary. We show that coterminous governance requires an architectural decision (separatingcomputation from effect) rather than a governance layer added after the fact. We show that structural governance under this separation subsumes separate governance infrastructure: governance checks become part of the execution pipeline rather than a second system running alongside it. We propose coterminous governance as the testable criterion for any AI governance system: either the two boundaries are provably identical, or risk and theater are structurally inevitable. Proofs are mechanized in Coq (454 theorems, 36 modules, 0 admitted).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"同延治理"(coterminous governance)概念，指出AI系统的表达能力边界与治理边界之间的结构性不匹配会导致未治理的能力（风险）和治理不存在的功能（作秀）。通过Rice定理证明行为层面治理效果不可判定，主张通过架构决策（计算与效果分离）而非事后添加治理层来实现同延治理。
AI.motivation: 当前几乎所有AI系统的表达能力边界与治理边界是独立定义的，导致三个区域：受治理能力（有用）、未治理能力（风险）、治理不存在的功能（作秀）。其中两个区域是失败模式，亟需解决这一结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义治理效果（AI系统在现实世界中的动作，如API调用、数据库写入等）与模型输出治理的区分。2. 应用Rice定理证明在行为层面治理效果的不可判定性。3. 提出同延治理概念并论证其需要计算与效果的架构分离。4. 用Coq定理证明器实现454个定理、36个模块的形式化验证。
AI.result: 1. 证明对于图灵完备架构，行为层面的效果治理存在不可判定性缺陷。2. 提出同延治理标准：表达能力边界等于治理边界。3. 证明同延治理需要计算-效果分离的架构决策。4. 形式化证明了结构治理下治理检查成为执行管线的一部分。
AI.conclusion: 同延治理是可测试的AI治理系统标准——要么两个边界可证明相等，要么风险和作秀在结构上不可避免。Coq形式化验证了454个定理。
idea_en: An architecture for AI systems that separates computation from effect (e.g., API calls, database writes) at the architectural level, enabling coterminous governance where expressiveness boundary equals governance boundary.
A formal verification framework (mechanized in Coq) for proving that an AI system's governance boundary matches its expressiveness boundary, with 454 theorems and 36 modules.
A structural governance method where governance checks are embedded into the execution pipeline rather than a separate parallel system, eliminating the gap between governance and capabilities.
A method for distinguishing governance of effects (actions in the world) from governance of model outputs, with different mechanisms for each layer.
A system design criterion for AI safety: coterminous governance as a testable property requiring the governance boundary to be provably identical to the expressiveness boundary.
idea_ch: 一种将计算与效果（如API调用、数据库写入）在架构层面分离的AI系统设计，实现表达边界与治理边界相等的同延治理。
基于Coq定理证明器的形式化验证框架（454个定理、36个模块），用于证明AI系统的治理边界与表达能力边界一致。
一种结构治理方法，将治理检查嵌入执行管线而非作为并行系统运行，消除治理与能力之间的结构性鸿沟。
区分效果治理（现实世界动作）与模型输出治理的方法，为不同层级设计不同的治理机制。
一种AI系统可测试的治理标准——同延治理，要求治理边界与表达能力边界可证明相等，而非事后添加治理层。

title: Learning Rate Engineering: From Coarse Single Parameter to Layered Evolution
summary: Learning rate scheduling has evolved from the single global fixed rate of early SGD to sophisticated layer-wise adaptive strategies. We systematize this evolution into five generations: (Gen1) global fixed learning rates, (Gen2) global scheduling, (Gen3) parameter-level adaptation, (Gen4) layer-level differentiation, and (Gen5) joint layer-time scheduling. We trace the fundamental motivation behind each transition, showing how the shift from one-size-fits-all to tailoring by layer and time addresses the impossible trinity of transfer learning: lower layers require small updates to preserve general knowledge while higher layers need large updates to adapt to new tasks. Building on this taxonomy, we propose Discriminative Adaptive Layer Scaling (DALS), a unified framework that integrates phase-adaptive cosine scheduling, depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering, and LARS-style trust ratios into a single coherent optimizer. We benchmark 18 strategies including three DALS variants across all five generations on five datasets: synthetic, CIFAR-10 (from scratch), RTE, TREC-6, and IMDb (fine-tuning). On synthetic, DALS achieves the best accuracy at 98.0%, while DALS-Fast reaches 90% in just 3 epochs. The cross-dataset analysis reveals striking regime-dependent patterns -- no single strategy wins across all regimes. Critically, STLR+Discriminative, the ULMFiT champion, catastrophically fails on from-scratch tasks (43.6% on TREC-6 from scratch vs. 96.8% with RAdam), confirming that directional decay biases are harmful without pretrained features. DALS avoids either extreme, achieving the best synthetic result while maintaining competitive fine-tuning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统化学习率调度策略的五代演进，并提出统一框架DALS（判别式自适应层缩放），在多种数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决迁移学习中的"不可能三角"：低层需小更新保留通用知识，高层需大更新适应新任务，现有单一策略无法兼顾。
AI.method: 提出DALS框架，集成相位自适应余弦调度、深度感知Grokfast梯度滤波、LARS风格信任比，实现层和时间的联合调度。
AI.result: 合成数据最佳准确率98.0%，DALS-Fast 3轮达90%；跨数据集分析显示无单一策略通用；STLR+Discriminative在从头训练任务中失败（43.6% vs 96.8%）。
AI.conclusion: DALS避免极端，在合成数据最优的同时保持微调性能竞争力；不同训练场景需匹配不同调度策略。
idea_en: Discriminative Adaptive Layer Scaling (DALS): A unified framework integrating phase-adaptive cosine scheduling, depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering, and LARS-style trust ratios for joint layer-time learning rate scheduling.
Phase-adaptive cosine scheduling: Dynamically adjusting cosine annealing schedule based on training phases to optimize learning rate decay patterns.

Depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering: Using network depth information to filter gradients differently across layers, preventing forgetting in lower layers while enabling fast adaptation in higher layers.
Joint layer-time scheduling (Gen5): A novel paradigm that simultaneously optimizes learning rates across both layer dimension and time dimension.
Cross-regime analysis methodology: Systematic benchmarking framework revealing regime-dependent patterns where different scheduling strategies excel in different training scenarios.

STLR+Discriminative failure detection: Identifying that directional decay biases catastrophically fail in from-scratch training (43.6% vs 96.8% accuracy), establishing critical boundary conditions for transfer learning scheduling.
idea_ch: 判别式自适应层缩放（DALS）：集成相位自适应余弦调度、深度感知Grokfast梯度滤波和LARS风格信任比的统一框架，实现层与时间的联合学习率调度。
相位自适应余弦调度：基于训练阶段动态调整余弦退火调度策略，优化学习率衰减模式。
深度感知Grokfast梯度滤波：利用网络深度信息对不同层进行差异化梯度滤波，低层防止遗忘通用知识，高层实现快速适应。
联合层-时间调度：同时在层维度和时间维度优化学习率的新型调度范式，解决迁移学习的不可能三角。
跨场景分析框架：系统基准测试方法揭示不同调度策略在不同训练场景下的性能依赖模式，为策略选择提供指导。
STLR+Discriminative失败边界发现：识别出方向性衰减偏置在从头训练任务中灾难性失效（43.6% vs 96.8%），建立了迁移学习调度的关键边界条件。

title: Machine Collective Intelligence for Explainable Scientific Discovery
summary: Deriving governing equations from empirical observations is a longstanding challenge in science. Although artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated substantial capabilities in function approximation, the discovery of explainable and extrapolatable equations remains a fundamental limitation of modern AI, posing a central bottleneck for AI-driven scientific discovery. Here, we present machine collective intelligence, a unified paradigm that integrates two fundamental yet distinct traditions in computational intelligence--symbolism and metaheuristics--to enable autonomous and evolutionary discovery of governing equations. It orchestrates multiple reasoning agents to evolve their symbolic hypotheses through coordinated generation, evaluation, critique, and consolidation, enabling scientific discovery beyond single-agent inference. Across scientific systems governed by deterministic, stochastic, or previously uncharacterized dynamics, machine collective intelligence autonomously recovered the underlying governing equations without relying on hand-crafted domain knowledge. Furthermore, the resulting equations reduced extrapolation error by up to six orders of magnitude relative to deep neural networks, while condensing 0.5-1 million model parameters into just 5-40 interpretable parameters. This study marks an important shift in AI toward the autonomous discovery of principled scientific equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出机器集体智能（Machine Collective Intelligence）范式，融合符号主义与元启发式算法，通过多推理智能体协同进化，从经验数据中自主发现可解释、可外推的控制方程，性能远超深度神经网络。
AI.motivation: 从经验观测中推导控制方程是科学中的长期挑战，现有AI虽擅长函数逼近，但无法发现可解释且可外推的方程，这成为AI驱动科学发现的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出机器集体智能范式，融合符号主义（symbolism）与元启发式算法（metaheuristics），通过协调多个推理智能体（reasoning agents），以生成、评估、批评、整合（generation, evaluation, critique, and consolidation）的循环方式协同进化符号化假设，实现超越单智能体推理的科学发现。
AI.result: 在确定性、随机性或先前未被表征的动力系统中，机器集体智能能够自主恢复潜在的控制方程，无需手工领域知识。外推误差相比深度神经网络降低最多六个数量级，并将50-100万个模型参数压缩至仅5-40个可解释参数。
AI.conclusion: 该研究标志着AI向自主发现原理性科学方程的重要转变。
idea_en: A multi-agent collaborative evolutionary framework that integrates symbolic reasoning with metaheuristic optimization for autonomous discovery of governing equations from empirical data.

A coordinated generation-evaluation-critique-consolidation loop mechanism that enables multiple reasoning agents to iteratively refine symbolic hypotheses without requiring hand-crafted domain knowledge.
A method for compressing millions of neural network parameters into a compact set of 5-40 interpretable symbolic parameters while reducing extrapolation error by up to six orders of magnitude.
A unified machine collective intelligence architecture capable of discovering governing equations for deterministic, stochastic, and previously uncharacterized dynamical systems.

一种协调生成-评估-批评-整合的循环机制，多个推理智能体无需手工领域知识即可迭代优化符号化假设
将数百万神经网络参数压缩至5-40个可解释符号参数，同时将外推误差降低多达六个数量级的方法

title: METASYMBO: Multi-Agent Language-Guided Metamaterial Discovery via Symbolic Latent Evolution
summary: Metamaterial discovery seeks microstructured materials whose geometry induces targeted mechanical behavior. Existing inverse-design methods can efficiently generate candidates, but they typically require explicit numerical property targets and are less suitable for early-stage exploration, where researchers often begin with incomplete constraints and qualitative intents expressed in natural language. Large language models can interpret such intents, but they lack geometric awareness and physical property validity. To address this gap, we propose MetaSymbO, a multi-agent framework for language-guided Metamaterial discovery via Symbolic-driven latent evOlution. Specifically, MetaSymbO contains three agents: a Designer that interprets free-form design intents and retrieves a semantically consistent scaffold, a Generator that synthesizes candidate microstructures in a disentangled latent space, and a Supervisor that provides fast property-aware feedback for iterative refinement. To move beyond the limitations of reproducing known samples from literature and training data, we further introduce symbolic-driven latent evolution, which applies programmable operators over disentangled latent factors to compose, modify, and refine structures at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that (i) MetaSymbO improves structural validity by up to 34% in symmetry and nearly 98% in periodicity compared to state-of-the-art baselines; (ii) MetaSymbO achieves about 6-7% higher language-guidance scores while maintaining superior structure novelty compared to advanced reasoning LLMs; (iii) qualitative analyses confirm the effectiveness of symbolic logic operators in enabling programmable semantic alignment; and (iv) realworld case studies on auxetic, high-stiffness metamaterial design further validate its practical capability.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaSymbO，一个基于多智能体框架的元材料发现系统，通过符号驱动的潜在演化实现自然语言引导的微结构设计，在结构有效性、语言引导评分和结构新颖性上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有逆向设计方法需要明确的数值目标，不适合早期探索阶段研究人员用自然语言表达的定性意图；而大语言模型能理解自然语言但缺乏几何感知和物理属性有效性验证。
AI.method: MetaSymbO包含三个智能体：Designer（解释自由形式设计意图并检索语义一致骨架）、Generator（在解耦潜在空间中合成候选微结构）、Supervisor（提供快速属性感知反馈进行迭代优化）。引入符号驱动潜在演化，在推理时对解耦潜在因子应用可编程算子进行组合、修改和精炼。
AI.result: 结构有效性提升：对称性提升34%，周期性提升近98%；语言引导评分提升6-7%，同时保持结构新颖性优于先进推理LLM；定性分析验证了符号逻辑算子的可编程语义对齐有效性；实际案例验证了在负泊松比和高刚度元材料设计中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: MetaSymbO成功弥合了自然语言设计意图与物理有效微结构生成之间的鸿沟，符号驱动的潜在演化机制为超越训练数据限制的创新发现提供了新范式。

Symbolic-driven latent evolution method that applies programmable operators over disentangled latent factors to compose, modify, and refine structures at inference time
A disentangled latent space representation for microstructures that enables independent manipulation of geometric properties like symmetry and periodicity
A Supervisor agent that provides fast property-aware feedback for iterative refinement without requiring full numerical simulations
Semantic scaffold retrieval mechanism that maps natural language design intents to structurally consistent microstructure templates

title: End-to-End Evaluation and Governance of an EHR-Embedded AI Agent for Clinicians
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, submitted to npj Digital Medicine
summary: Clinical AI systems require not just point-in-time evaluation but continuous governance: the ongoing practice of monitoring, evaluating, iterating, and re-evaluating performance throughout deployment. We present an end-to-end framework of governance that integrates rubric validation, live deployment feedback, technical performance monitoring, and cost tracking, with controlled experimentation gating system changes before deployment. Applied to Hyperscribe, an EHR-embedded agent that converts ambient audio into structured chart updates, twenty clinicians authored 1,646 validated rubrics across 823 cases. Seven Hyperscribe versions were evaluated through controlled experiments, with median scores improving from 84% to 95%. Analysis of 107 live feedback entries over three months showed feedback composition shifting from 79% error reports and 14% positive observations to 30% errors and 45% positive observations as engineering interventions resolved failures. Median processing time per audio segment was 8.1 seconds with a 99.6% effective completion rate after retry mechanisms absorbed transient model errors. These results demonstrate that continuous, multi-channel governance of deployed clinical AI is both achievable and effective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向临床AI系统的持续治理框架，集成了验证、监控、迭代和成本追踪，并通过在Hyperscribe（EHR嵌入式环境音频转结构化病历的AI代理）上的实际部署验证了其有效性。20位临床医生在823个案例中创建了1,646个验证评估，7个版本的中位得分从84%提升至95%，反馈组成从79%错误报告转变为45%正面观察。
AI.motivation: 临床AI系统在部署后需要持续治理（监控、评估、迭代、再评估），而非仅一次性评估，但目前缺乏端到端的实践框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含四个维度的治理框架：(1) 标准验证集成，(2) 实时部署反馈收集，(3) 技术性能监控，(4) 成本追踪；并通过受控实验对系统变更进行门控验证。
AI.result: 7个Hyperscribe版本在受控实验中中位得分从84%提升至95%；107条实时反馈中错误报告占比从79%降至30%，正面观察从14%升至45%；中位处理时间8.1秒，重试机制下有效完成率99.6%。
AI.conclusion: 持续的多通道治理在部署的临床AI系统中是可行且有效的，能够显著提升系统质量和用户体验。

A rubric-based validation method where clinicians author standardized evaluation rubrics for AI-generated clinical documentation in EHR systems.
A feedback composition analysis system that tracks and categorizes live user feedback (error reports vs positive observations) over time to guide engineering interventions.
A retry mechanism architecture for clinical AI systems that absorbs transient model errors to achieve 99.6% effective completion rate while maintaining median processing time.
A controlled experimentation gating system that evaluates new AI versions against validated rubrics before deployment to production clinical environments.
A method for converting ambient audio into structured chart updates within EHR systems with continuous performance governance.

title: Investigating More Explainable and Partition-Free Compositionality Estimation for LLMs: A Rule-Generation Perspective
summary: Compositional generalization tests are often used to estimate the compositionality of LLMs. However, such tests have the following limitations: (1) they only focus on the output results without considering LLMs' understanding of sample compositionality, resulting in explainability defects; (2) they rely on dataset partition to form the test set with combinations unseen in the training set, suffering from combination leakage issues. In this work, we propose a novel rule-generation perspective for compositionality estimation for LLMs. It requires LLMs to generate a program as rules for dataset mapping and provides estimates of the compositionality of LLMs using complexity-based theory. The perspective addresses the limitations of compositional generalization tests and provides a new way to analyze the compositionality characterization of LLMs. We conduct experiments and analysis of existing advanced LLMs based on this perspective on a string-to-grid task, and find various compositionality characterizations and compositionality deficiencies exhibited by LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于规则生成的新视角来评估大语言模型的组合性，通过让LLMs生成程序作为数据集映射规则，并利用基于复杂度的理论来估计其组合性，克服了传统组合泛化测试仅关注输出结果、存在可解释性缺陷和组合泄露问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的组合泛化测试存在两个主要局限：(1)只关注输出结果，不考虑LLMs对样本组合性的理解，导致可解释性缺陷；(2)依赖数据集划分来形成测试集，存在组合泄露问题。因此需要一种新的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出规则生成视角：要求LLMs生成程序作为数据集映射的规则，利用基于复杂度的理论估计LLMs的组合性。在字符串到网格(string-to-grid)任务上进行实验分析。
AI.result: 在现有先进LLMs上发现它们表现出不同的组合性特征和组合性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 规则生成视角能够解决传统组合泛化测试的局限性，为分析LLMs的组合性表征提供了新方法。
idea_en: A method for evaluating LLM compositionality by requiring the model to generate programmatic rules that map datasets, with compositionality estimates derived from complexity-based theory rather than output-only tests.
A rule-generation framework for compositional analysis that uses program synthesis tasks (e.g., string-to-grid mapping) to probe LLMs' understanding of compositional structures.
A technique to detect combination leakage in compositional generalization tests by using rule-generation perspective instead of dataset partition-based approaches.
A complexity-based metric system for quantifying compositionality in LLMs by analyzing the structure and complexity of generated rule programs.
idea_ch: 一种通过要求模型生成数据集映射的程序规则并利用基于复杂度的理论来估计组合性的LLM组合性评估方法。
