一种通过分析生成规则程序的结构和复杂度来量化LLM组合性的基于复杂度的度量系统。

title: Heterogeneous Scientific Foundation Model Collaboration
summary: Agentic large language model systems have demonstrated strong capabilities. However, their reliance on language as the universal interface fundamentally limits their applicability to many real-world problems, especially in scientific domains where domain-specific foundation models have been developed to address specialized tasks beyond natural language. In this work, we introduce Eywa, a heterogeneous agentic framework designed to extend language-centric systems to a broader class of scientific foundation models. The key idea of Eywa is to augment domain-specific foundation models with a language-model-based reasoning interface, enabling language models to guide inference over non-linguistic data modalities. This design allows predictive foundation models, which are typically optimized for specialized data and tasks, to participate in higher-level reasoning and decision-making processes within agentic systems. Eywa can serve as a drop-in replacement for a single-agent pipeline (EywaAgent) or be integrated into existing multi-agent systems by replacing traditional agents with specialized agents (EywaMAS). We further investigate a planning-based orchestration framework in which a planner dynamically coordinates traditional agents and Eywa agents to solve complex tasks across heterogeneous data modalities (EywaOrchestra). We evaluate Eywa across a diverse set of scientific domains spanning physical, life, and social sciences. Experimental results demonstrate that Eywa improves performance on tasks involving structured and domain-specific data, while reducing reliance on language-based reasoning through effective collaboration with specialized foundation models.

AI.tldr: Eywa是一个异构智能体框架，通过为领域专用基础模型配备基于语言模型推理接口，扩展了以语言为中心的AI系统，使其能够处理科学领域的非语言数据模态。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体系统以语言作为通用接口，但在科学领域中，许多任务涉及领域专用基础模型处理的非语言数据，语言模型难以直接处理这些结构化数据，限制了其在实际科学问题中的应用。
AI.method: Eywa框架包含三个层次：(1) EywaAgent：单智能体流水线，将领域专用模型与语言模型推理接口结合；(2) EywaMAS：多智能体系统，用专业智能体替代传统智能体；(3) EywaOrchestra：基于规划的编排框架，通过规划器动态协调传统智能体和Eywa智能体完成跨数据模态的复杂任务。
AI.result: 在物理、生命和社会科学等多个科学领域的实验表明，Eywa在处理结构化和领域特定数据的任务上提升了性能，同时通过有效的专业基础模型协作减少了对语言推理的依赖。
AI.conclusion: Eywa成功将语言模型智能体的能力扩展到科学基础模型领域，通过异构智能体架构实现了跨模态推理，为科学AI系统的构建提供了新范式。

A drop-in single-agent pipeline (EywaAgent) that integrates predictive foundation models into language-model-driven reasoning and decision-making processes.
A multi-agent system (EywaMAS) where traditional agents are replaced with specialized agents capable of handling domain-specific data modalities.
A planning-based orchestration framework (EywaOrchestra) with a dynamic planner that coordinates traditional agents and Eywa agents to solve complex tasks across heterogeneous data modalities.
A method for reducing reliance on language-based reasoning by enabling effective collaboration between language models and specialized scientific foundation models.

title: CoAX: Cognitive-Oriented Attribution eXplanation User Model of Human Understanding of AI Explanations
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) aims to improve user understanding and decisions when using AI models. However, despite innovations in XAI, recent user evaluations reveal that this goal remains elusive. Understanding human cognition can help explain why users struggle to effectively use AI explanations. Focusing on reasoning on structured (tabular) data, we examined various reasoning strategies for different XAI methods (none, feature importance, feature attribution) in the decision task of anticipating AI decisions (i.e., forward simulation). We i) elicited reasoning strategies from a formative user study, and ii) collected decisions from a summative user study. Using cognitive modeling, we implemented the processes underlying each reasoning strategy and evaluated their alignment with human decision-making. We found that our models better fit human decisions than baseline machine learning proxies, providing insights into which reasoning strategies are (in)effective. We then demonstrate how the fitted model can be used to form hypotheses and investigate research questions that are costly to study with real human participants. This work contributes to debugging human understanding of XAI, informing the future development of more usable and interpretable AI explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过认知建模研究人类在使用XAI解释时的推理策略，发现不同XAI方法（无解释、特征重要性、特征归因）在结构化数据决策任务中影响用户对AI决策的前向模拟能力，并展示了如何用认知模型替代人类用户进行XAI效果评估。
AI.motivation: 尽管XAI技术不断创新，用户评估显示用户仍然难以有效利用AI解释来改善决策和理解。现有XAI研究缺乏对人类认知过程的理解，需要探究用户在使用不同XAI方法时实际采用的推理策略及其有效性。
AI.method: 1) 形成性用户研究获取推理策略；2) 总结性用户研究收集决策数据；3) 认知建模实现各推理策略的底层认知过程；4) 评估模型与人类决策的一致性；5) 用拟合模型替代人类进行假设检验。
AI.result: 认知模型比机器学习基线代理能更好地拟合人类决策，揭示了哪些推理策略有效或无效，并成功用拟合模型生成了假设并研究了难以用真人实验验证的研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 认知建模可有效诊断人类对XAI的理解问题，为开发更可用的AI解释提供指导，并可作为低成本的替代方案进行XAI效果评估研究。

System for diagnosing user reasoning strategies when interacting with different XAI methods (feature importance vs feature attribution) on structured data
Technique for predicting which XAI method leads to better forward simulation of AI decisions based on cognitive modeling of user reasoning
Framework for automated identification of ineffective reasoning strategies during human-AI decision making
Method for generating testable hypotheses about XAI usability through fitted cognitive models without requiring large-scale human studies

title: Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD): A Formal Framework for Runtime Delegation Safety in Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
As large language model (LLM) agents are deployed in high-stakes environments, the question of how safely to delegate subtasks to specialized sub-agents becomes critical. Existing work addresses multi-agent architecture selection at design time or provides broad empirical guidelines, but neither provides a runtime mechanism that dynamically adjusts the safety-efficiency trade-off as task context changes during execution.
  We propose Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD), a formal framework for runtime delegation safety in hierarchical multi-agent systems. SBD formulates task delegation as a bilevel optimization problem: an outer meta-weight network phi learns context-dependent safety-efficiency weights lambda(s) in [0,1]; an inner loop optimizes the delegation policy pi subject to a probabilistic safety constraint P(safe) >= 1-delta. The continuous delegation degree alpha in [0, 1] controls how much decision authority is transferred to each sub-agent, interpolating smoothly between full human override (alpha=0) and fully autonomous execution (alpha=1).
  We establish three theoretical results: (1) Safety Monotonicity--higher outer safety weight produces a weakly safer inner policy; (2) Inner Policy Convergence--projected gradient descent on the inner problem converges linearly under standard smoothness assumptions; (3) an Accountability Propagation bound that distributes responsibility across multi-hop delegation chains with a provable per-agent ceiling. We instantiate SBD in three high-stakes domains--medical AI (MIMIC-III), financial risk control (S and P 500), and educational agent supervision (ASSISTments)--specifying datasets, safety constraint sets, baselines, and evaluation protocols. This manuscript presents the formal framework and theoretical results in full; empirical validation following the protocols described herein is planned and will be reported in a forthcoming revision.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为安全双层委派（SBD）的形式化框架，用于在分层多智能体系统中实现运行时委派安全。SBD将任务委派建模为双层优化问题，通过内外两层循环动态调整安全-效率权衡，并理论上证明了安全单调性、内层策略收敛性和问责传播界限等三个核心性质。
AI.motivation: 在LLM智能体部署于高风险场景时，如何安全地将子任务委派给专业子智能体成为关键问题。现有工作仅在设计时选择多智能体架构或提供宽泛的经验准则，缺乏运行时机制来随任务上下文动态调整安全-效率权衡。
AI.method: SBD将任务委派形式化为双层优化问题：外层元权重网络phi学习依赖上下文的权重lambda(s)；内层优化委派策略pi，受概率安全约束P(safe) >= 1-delta。连续委派度alpha控制每个子智能体获得的决策权，在高风险时倾向人为干预，低风险时倾向自主执行。
AI.result: 建立了三个理论结果：安全单调性（更高安全性权重产生更安全的内层策略）、内层策略收敛性（投影梯度下降线性收敛）、问责传播界限（多跳委派链中每个智能体的责任上限可证明）。在医疗AI、金融风控、教育智能体监督三个高风险领域给出了具体的数据集、安全约束集、基线和评估协议。
AI.conclusion: SBD提供了首个形式化的运行时委派安全框架，通过可证明的安全保证和问责机制，有望在高风险环境中实现安全高效的自主决策委派。实证验证将在后续版本中报告。
idea_en: A bilevel optimization-based runtime delegation framework for hierarchical multi-agent systems that dynamically adjusts safety-efficiency trade-offs through context-dependent weight learning.

A continuous delegation degree mechanism (alpha in [0,1]) that smoothly interpolates between full human override and full autonomous execution, enabling granular control over sub-agent decision authority.
A meta-weight network that learns context-dependent safety-efficiency weights lambda(s) in real-time based on task context changes during execution.
Probabilistic safety constraint formulation P(safe) >= 1-delta for delegation policy optimization, providing formal guarantees for safe subtask assignment.
Safety Monotonicity theorem proving that higher outer safety weight produces a weakly safer inner policy in hierarchical multi-agent systems.
Inner Policy Convergence theorem showing projected gradient descent on the bilevel delegation problem converges linearly under standard smoothness assumptions.
Accountability Propagation bound that distributes responsibility across multi-hop delegation chains with a provable per-agent ceiling.

A formal framework instantiated with specific datasets, safety constraint sets, baselines, and evaluation protocols across three high-stakes domains: medical AI (MIMIC-III), financial risk control (S&P 500), and educational agent supervision (ASSISTments).
idea_ch: 一种基于双层优化的分级多智能体系统运行时委派框架，通过上下文依赖的权重学习动态调整安全-效率权衡。
连续委派度机制（alpha在0到1之间），在完全人为干预和完全自主执行之间平滑插值，实现对子智能体决策权限的精细控制。
元权重网络根据任务上下文变化实时学习依赖上下文的安全-效率权重lambda(s)。

title: TIO-SHACL: Comprehensive SHACL validation for TMF Intent Ontologies
summary: Intent-based networking promises to revolutionize telecommunications network management by enabling operators to specify high-level goals rather than low-level configurations. The TM Forum Intent Ontology (tio) provides a standardized vocabulary for expressing network intents, yet lacks formal validation mechanisms to ensure intent correctness before its admission. We present tio-shacl, the first comprehensive SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) validation framework for the TMF Intent Ontology. Our contribution includes 56 node shapes and 69 property shapes across all 15 tio v3.6.0 ontology modules, a reusable constraint library with 25 parameterized SPARQL-based constraint components, and novel validation patterns for recursive logical operators, quantity-based constraints, and cross-expectation relationships. We pursued 100% vocabulary coverage (87 classes, 109 properties, 72 functions), cross-implementation compatibility across three major SHACL engines, and validation accuracy on a corpus of 133 test cases. tio-shacl is publicly available under MIT license at https://github.com/EricssonResearch/tio-shacl and enables automated syntactic and semantic validation of network intents, addressing a critical gap in the field.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了tio-shacl，首个针对TMF意图本体的全面SHACL验证框架，包含56个节点形状、69个属性形状、25个可复用SPARQL约束组件，覆盖全部15个本体模块，实现了网络意图的自动化语法和语义验证。
AI.motivation: TM Forum Intent Ontology (tio) 虽然提供了标准化词汇表用于表达网络意图，但缺乏正式的验证机制来确保意图在被接纳前的正确性，存在关键空白。
AI.method: 基于SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) 构建验证框架，包括节点形状、属性形状、可复用的参数化SPARQL约束组件，以及针对递归逻辑运算符、基于数量的约束和跨期望关系的新型验证模式。
AI.result: 100%词汇覆盖率（87个类、109个属性、72个函数），跨三个主流SHACL引擎的兼容性，在133个测试用例上的验证准确性。
AI.conclusion: tio-shacl填补了意图驱动网络中意图正式验证机制的关键空白，以MIT许可证开源发布，可自动化验证网络意图的语法和语义正确性。

A reusable constraint library with parameterized SPARQL-based constraint components for validating network intents, enabling flexible customization without rewriting validation logic.
Novel validation patterns for recursive logical operators in network intent expressions, allowing correct validation of nested AND/OR conditions.

A comprehensive SHACL shape coverage methodology achieving 100% vocabulary coverage across all modules of a domain ontology.

title: Measurement Risk in Supervised Financial NLP: Rubric and Metric Sensitivity on JF-ICR
comment: 16 Pages, Submitted to IEEE Computational Intelligence in Financial Engineering and Economics (CIFEr) 2026, Tokyo, JP
summary: As LLMs become credible readers of earnings calls, investor-relations Q\&A, guidance, and disclosure language, supervised financial NLP benchmarks increasingly function as decision evidence for model selection and deployment. A hidden assumption is that gold labels make such evidence objective. This assumption breaks down when the benchmark ruler itself is sensitive to rubric wording, metric choice, or aggregation policy. We study this measurement risk on Japanese Financial Implicit-Commitment Recognition (JF-ICR; a pinned 253-item test split x 4 frontier LLMs x 5 rubrics x 3 temperatures x 5 ordinal metrics). Three findings follow. First, rubric wording materially changes model-assigned labels: R2--R3 agreement ranges from 70.0% to 83.4%, with the dominant movement near the +1 / 0 implicit-commitment boundary. This pattern is consistent with a pragmatic-boundary interpretation, but is not a validated linguistic-causality claim because the present rubric variants confound semantics, examples, and verbosity. Second, not every metric remains informative under the JF-ICR class distribution. Within-one accuracy is too easy because near misses receive credit and the majority class dominates; worst-class accuracy is too noisy because the rarest class has only two examples. Exact accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted \k{appa} are therefore the identifiable metrics under our operational rule. Third, ranking claims become more defensible only after this metric-identifiability audit: Bradley--Terry, Borda, and Ranked Pairs agree on the identifiable metric subset, while the full five-metric sweep produces disagreement on the closest pair. The contribution is not a new leaderboard, but a reporting discipline for supervised financial benchmarks whose gold labels exist and whose evaluation ruler still requires governance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了金融NLP基准测试中的“测量风险”，发现评分标准措辞、指标选择和聚合策略会显著影响模型排名结果，并提出了指标可识别性审计方法以提高排名可信度。
AI.motivation: 揭示金融NLP基准测试中黄金标签看似客观，但评分标准、指标选择和聚合策略等测量环节存在主观性风险，可能导致模型选择和部署决策失当。
AI.method: 以日本金融隐含承诺识别（JF-ICR）任务为案例，设计253项测试样本×4个前沿LLM×5种评分标准×3个温度参数×5种序数指标的实验矩阵，系统分析措辞变动、指标选择对标签分配和模型排名的影响。
AI.result: （1）评分标准措辞使模型标签发生实质性变化，R2-R3一致性仅70.0%-83.4%；（2）并非所有指标在JF-ICR类别分布下都有效，精确准确率、宏观F1和加权κ是可识别指标；（3）经指标可识别性审计后，Bradley-Terry、Borda和Ranked Pairs在可识别子集上达成排名一致，而全五指标集则在最近邻对上产生分歧。
AI.conclusion: 贡献不在于提出新的排行榜，而是建立一种监督式金融基准测试的报告规范：即使黄金标签存在，评估标尺仍需治理。
idea_en: A method for auditing metric identifiability in supervised financial NLP benchmarks, comprising: computing multiple ordinal metrics across model-rubric-temperature combinations; applying an operational rule to identify which metrics remain informative under the target class distribution; and using only the identifiable metric subset for model ranking via Bradley-Terry, Borda, or Ranked Pairs aggregation.

A system for detecting rubric-wording sensitivity in financial NLP tasks, comprising: generating multiple rubric variants that confound semantics, examples, and verbosity; measuring inter-rubber agreement rates; and identifying pragmatic-boundary effects near the implicit-commitment decision threshold (+1/0 boundary).

A benchmark governance framework for financial NLP evaluation, comprising: a pre-defined operational rule for metric selection based on class distribution statistics (e.g., within-one accuracy too easy, worst-class accuracy too noisy); a metric-identifiability audit step before ranking aggregation; and a reporting discipline that discloses measurement risk alongside benchmark results.
idea_ch: 一种面向金融NLP基准测试的指标可识别性审计方法，包括：计算跨模型-评分标准-温度组合的多个序数指标；根据目标类别分布应用操作性规则识别有效指标；仅使用可识别指标子集通过Bradley-Terry、Borda或Ranked Pairs聚合进行模型排名。

title: Robust Learning on Heterogeneous Graphs with Heterophily: A Graph Structure Learning Approach
summary: Heterogeneous graphs with heterophily have emerged as a powerful abstraction for modeling complex real-world systems, where nodes of different types and labels interact in diverse and often non-homophilous ways. Despite recent advances, robust representation learning for such graphs remains largely unexplored, particularly in the presence of noisy or misleading connectivity. In this work, we investigate this problem and identify structural noise as a critical challenge that significantly degrades model performance. To address this issue, we propose a unified framework, Heterogeneous Graph Unified Learning (HGUL), which jointly handles heterophily and noisy graph structures. The framework consists of three complementary modules: a kNN-based graph construction module that recovers reliable local neighborhoods, a graph structure learning module that adaptively refines the adjacency by filtering noisy edges, and a heterogeneous affinity learning module that captures class-level relationships via an extended affinity matrix derived from a polynomial graph kernel. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that HGUL consistently outperforms existing methods on clean graphs and maintains strong robustness under varying levels of structural noise. The results further underscore the importance of jointly modeling heterophily and noise in heterogeneous graph learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HGUL统一框架，联合处理异质图中的异质性（heterophily）和结构噪声问题，通过kNN图构建、图结构学习和异质亲和力学习三个模块，在干净和有噪声的图上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 异质图广泛存在于现实系统中，但现有方法未能同时处理异质性（heterophily）和结构噪声这两个关键挑战，导致模型在噪声图结构下性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出HGUL框架，包含三个互补模块：(1) kNN-based图构建模块，恢复可靠的局部邻域；(2) 图结构学习模块，通过过滤噪声边自适应精炼邻接矩阵；(3) 异质亲和力学习模块，利用多项式图核扩展的亲和矩阵捕获类级关系。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，HGUL在干净图上持续优于现有方法，并在不同程度的结构噪声下保持强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模异质性和噪声对于异质图学习至关重要，HGUL为此提供了一种统一有效的解决方案。

A graph structure learning module that adaptively refines adjacency matrix by filtering noisy edges
A heterogeneous affinity learning module that captures class-level relationships using an extended affinity matrix derived from a polynomial graph kernel
A polynomial graph kernel-based method for constructing extended affinity matrices to model class-level relationships in heterogeneous graphs

title: Leading Across the Spectrum of Human-AI Relationships: A Conceptual Framework for Increasingly Heterogeneous Teams
summary:
What shapes a consequential decision when human and artificial intelligence work on it together? The answer is becoming harder to see. A decision may look human-led after AI has set the frame, or appear automated while human judgment still carries decisive force. This paper offers a leadership-facing spectrum to see those relationships within a bounded mandate: Pure Human, Centaur (human-dominant, with AI in the loop), Co-equal, Minotaur (AI-dominant, with humans in the loop), and Pure AI.
  The spectrum asks where leadership work occurs: who frames the problem, who redirects the work, and who can answer for what follows. The five positions are landmarks that help leaders recognize configurations as they layer, drift, or change in a single decision. The central risk is misrecognition: leaders may keep a human-centered story in place after decision-shaping authority has shifted elsewhere. They may believe oversight remains meaningful when it has become ceremonial, or keep humans in the loop when their involvement could make the decision worse. The framework introduces co-adaptability, the capacity of a configuration to improve as human and non-human participants adjust together, and places it within heterogeneous teaming, where participants may vary by number, substrate, model architecture, capability, speed, memory, and form of participation.
  The aim is practical: to help strategic leaders and those designing or deploying AI systems recognize the configuration at work, notice when it shifts, and judge whether it fits the decision before them. These configurations will shape how power, responsibility, and trust are distributed in organizational life. Whether the futures they help create remain governable and worth inhabiting will depend on leaders who can see, early enough, where and how consequential decisions are actually being shaped.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向领导者的决策配置光谱，用于识别和理解人机协作中领导力、权力与责任的实际分布位置，涵盖从纯人类到纯AI的五种模式。
AI.motivation: 在人类与AI共同决策的场景中，谁真正主导决策变得越来越模糊。领导者可能误以为决策仍由人类主导，而实际上决策框架已被AI设定；或误以为监督有效，实则已沦为仪式性存在。需要一个工具帮助领导者看清这些关系。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含五个位置的决策配置光谱：纯人类、人马（人类主导，AI在环）、对等共存、米诺陶（AI主导，人类在环）、纯AI。通过三个关键问题（谁定义问题、谁调整方向、谁为后果负责）来定位领导力所在。引入"共适应性"概念，衡量配置中人机共同改进的能力。
AI.result: 提供了一个实用的框架，帮助战略领导者识别当前决策配置、察觉配置漂移、判断配置是否适合当前决策场景。指出核心风险是"误认"——领导者可能维持人类中心叙事，而决策塑造权已转移。
AI.conclusion: 人机决策配置将深刻影响组织中权力、责任和信任的分配。未来是否可控、是否值得栖居，取决于领导者能否及早看清决策实际如何形成。
idea_en: A leadership-facing decision configuration spectrum (Pure Human, Centaur, Co-equal, Minotaur, Pure AI) for identifying who actually frames, redirects, and takes responsibility for decisions in human-AI collaboration
A method for detecting configuration drift and misrecognition risk in human-AI decision systems, where leaders may believe decision authority remains human-centered after it has shifted to AI

Co-adaptability metric for heterogeneous AI-human teams, measuring the capacity of a decision configuration to improve as participants with different substrates, architectures, capabilities, speeds, and memory adjust together

A framework for classifying leadership work in bounded mandates: identifying where problem-framing authority, re-direction authority, and accountability actually reside in hybrid decision-making systems

title: InteractWeb-Bench: Can Multimodal Agent Escape Blind Execution in Interactive Website Generation?
summary: With the advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents, the website development has shifted from manual programming to agent-based project-level code synthesis. Existing benchmarks rely on idealized assumptions, especially for well-structured, information-rich inputs and static execution settings. In contrast, real-world development is constrained by a critical bottleneck: the semantic misalignment between ambiguous, low-quality instructions from non-expert users and model understanding, which results in a failure mode that we term blind execution. To address this gap, we introduce InteractWeb-Bench, the first multimodal interactive benchmark for website generation under non-expert low-code user conditions. InteractWeb-Bench introduces four types of user agents and persona-driven instruction perturbations to systematically simulate diverse user behaviors, including ambiguity, redundancy, and contradiction, grounded in requirement engineering defect taxonomies. We develop an interactive execution environment for agents, featuring a unified action space comprising Clarify, Implement, Verify, and Submit, enabling iterative intent refinement, code synthesis, and visual feedback-based validation. Extensive experiments and analysis reveal that frontier MLLM-based agents remain trapped in blind execution, exposing limitations in intent recognition and adaptive interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InteractWeb-Bench，首个面向非专业用户在低代码条件下进行网站生成的多模态交互基准，通过模拟含歧义、冗余和矛盾的模糊用户指令，测试多模态大模型与编码代理在网站开发中的意图识别与自适应交互能力，揭示现有模型存在"盲目执行"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有网站生成基准基于理想化假设（结构良好、信息丰富的输入和静态执行环境），但真实开发中非专业用户提供的指令往往模糊、低质量，导致模型与用户意图之间的语义错配，即"盲目执行"问题。现有基准无法评估和推动模型在此类真实场景下的表现。
AI.method: 1) 四种用户代理类型（模拟不同行为模式）；2) 基于需求工程缺陷分类法的人物驱动指令扰动（引入歧义、冗余、矛盾）；3) 交互执行环境，统一动作空间包括Clarify（澄清）、Implement（实现）、Verify（验证）、Submit（提交），支持迭代式意图精炼、代码合成和基于视觉反馈的验证。
AI.result: 实验发现前沿多模态大模型（MLLM）代理在面对非专业用户的模糊指令时仍陷入"盲目执行"，在意图识别和自适应交互方面存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: InteractWeb-Bench填补了现有基准在模拟真实低代码用户行为方面的空白，揭示了当前MLLM代理在非理想输入条件下的关键不足，为未来研究提供了更具挑战性和实用性的评估框架。

title: PRTS: A Primitive Reasoning and Tasking System via Contrastive Representations
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic control via strong visual-linguistic priors. However, existing VLAs predominantly frame pretraining as supervised behavior cloning, overlooking the fundamental nature of robot learning as a goal-reaching process that requires understanding temporal task progress. We present \textbf{PRTS} (\textbf{P}rimitive \textbf{R}easoning and \textbf{T}asking \textbf{S}ystem), a VLA foundation model that reformulates pretraining through Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning. By treating language instructions as goals and employing contrastive reinforcement learning, PRTS learns a unified embedding space where the inner product of state-action and goal embeddings approximates the log-discounted goal occupancy, the probability of reaching the language-specified goal from the current state-action, quantitatively assessing physical feasibility beyond static semantic matching. PRTS draws this dense goal-reachability supervision directly from offline trajectories without reward annotations, and folds it into the VLM backbone via a role-aware causal mask, incurring negligible overhead over vanilla behavior cloning. This paradigm endows the high-level reasoning system with intrinsic goal reachability awareness, bridging semantic reasoning and temporal task progress, and further benefits goal-conditioned action prediction. Pretrained on 167B tokens of diverse manipulation and embodied-reasoning data, PRTS reaches state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and a real-world suite of 14 complex tasks, with particularly substantial gains on long-horizon, contact-rich, and zero-shot novel-instruction settings, confirming that injecting goal-reachability awareness significantly improves both execution success and long-horizon planning of general-purpose robotic foundation policies.

AI.tldr: PRTS是一个基于目标条件强化学习的VLA基础模型，通过对比强化学习将语言指令作为目标，学习统一的嵌入空间来评估物理可行性，在多个机器人基准测试中达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型主要采用监督行为克隆进行预训练，忽略了机器人学习的本质是一个需要理解时间任务进度的目标达成过程，缺乏对目标可达性的内在感知能力。
AI.method: 将语言指令作为目标，采用对比强化学习学习统一的嵌入空间，其中状态-动作嵌入与目标嵌入的内积近似对数折扣目标占用概率；从离线轨迹中提取密集目标可达性监督信号，通过角色感知因果掩码融入VLM骨干网络。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv及14个真实世界复杂任务上达到SOTA，尤其在长时序、接触密集和零样本新指令场景中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 注入目标可达性意识显著提高了通用机器人基础策略的执行成功率和长时序规划能力，桥接了语义推理与时间任务进度之间的鸿沟。
idea_en: A VLA foundation model that reformulates pretraining through Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning using contrastive reinforcement learning to learn a unified embedding space where inner product of state-action and goal embeddings approximates log-discounted goal occupancy.

A method for drawing dense goal-reachability supervision directly from offline trajectories without reward annotations, using a role-aware causal mask to integrate into VLM backbone with negligible overhead over behavior cloning.

A goal-reachability awareness mechanism that quantitatively assesses physical feasibility of reaching language-specified goals beyond static semantic matching, enabling intrinsic understanding of temporal task progress.
A system that treats language instructions as goals in a goal-conditioned RL framework, learning to evaluate probability of reaching the language-specified goal from current state-action pairs.
idea_ch: 一种基于目标条件强化学习的VLA基础模型预训练方法，利用对比强化学习学习统一的嵌入空间，使状态-动作嵌入与目标嵌入的内积近似对数折扣目标占用概率。
一种无需奖励标注的离线轨迹密集目标可达性监督信号提取方法，通过角色感知因果掩码将其融入VLM骨干网络，开销可忽略不计。
一种目标可达性感知机制，能够定量评估从当前状态-动作到达语言指定目标的物理可行性，超越静态语义匹配，实现时间任务进度的内在理解。
一种将语言指令视为强化学习目标的系统，学习从当前状态-动作对到达语言指定目标的概率评估方法。

title: Belief-Guided Inference Control for Large Language Model Services via Verifiable Observations
summary: In black-box large language model (LLM) services, response reliability is often only partially observable at decision time, while stronger inference pathways incur substantial computational cost, inducing a budgeted sequential decision problem: for each request, the system should decide whether the default low-cost response is sufficiently reliable or whether additional computation should be allocated to improve response quality. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Ver}ifiable \textbf{O}bservations for Risk-aware \textbf{I}nference \textbf{C}ontrol (\textsc{Veroic}), a framework for adaptive inference control in black-box LLM settings, which formulates request-time control as a \textit{partially observable Markov decision process} to capture partial observability and sequential budget coupling. It constructs a lightweight verifiable observation channel from the input-output pair by aggregating heterogeneous quality signals into a belief state over latent response reliability, which is then used by a budget-aware policy to decide whether to return the default output or trigger a higher-cost inference pathway. Experiments on diverse tasks show that \textsc{Veroic} achieves improved quality-cost trade-offs, stronger risk estimation and calibration, and more robust long-horizon inference control than competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Veroic框架，将黑盒LLM服务中的推理控制建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），通过轻量级可验证观察通道聚合异构质量信号，实现预算约束下的自适应推理决策，在质量-成本权衡、风险估计和长周期控制上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 黑盒LLM服务的响应可靠性在决策时仅部分可观测，而更强推理路径计算成本高，需要在低成本的默认响应与高成本的高质量推理之间做出预算约束下的序贯决策。
AI.method: 将请求时控制建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），从输入-输出对构建轻量级可验证观察通道，聚合异构质量信号为关于潜在响应可靠性的置信状态，再由预算感知策略决定是否返回默认输出或触发更高成本的推理路径。
AI.result: 在多样任务上的实验表明，Veroic在质量-成本权衡、风险估计与校准、以及长周期推理控制方面均优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: Veroic框架通过POMDP建模和可验证观察通道，有效解决了黑盒LLM服务中部分可观测性与预算耦合的挑战，实现了更可靠和经济的推理控制。
idea_en: A method for adaptive inference control in black-box LLM services by formulating request-time control as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) to capture partial observability and sequential budget coupling.
A lightweight verifiable observation channel that aggregates heterogeneous quality signals from input-output pairs into a belief state over latent response reliability.
A budget-aware policy that decides whether to return a default low-cost output or trigger a higher-cost inference pathway based on the belief state.
A risk-aware inference control framework that provides stronger risk estimation and calibration for LLM responses under budget constraints.
A system for long-horizon inference control that achieves robust quality-cost trade-offs across sequential LLM requests.
idea_ch: 一种将黑盒LLM服务中的请求时控制建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的自适应推理控制方法，捕获部分可观测性和序贯预算耦合。
一种轻量级可验证观察通道，从输入-输出对聚合异构质量信号，构建关于潜在响应可靠性的置信状态。
一种预算感知策略，基于置信状态决定是返回默认低成本输出还是触发更高成本的推理路径。
一种风险感知推理控制框架，在预算约束下提供更强的LLM响应风险估计与校准能力。
一种长周期推理控制系统，在连续LLM请求中实现稳健的质量-成本权衡。

title: In-Context Examples Suppress Scientific Knowledge Recall in LLMs
summary: Scientific reasoning rarely stops at what is directly observable; it often requires uncovering hidden structure from data. From estimating reaction constants in chemistry to inferring demand elasticities in economics, this latent structure recovery is what distinguishes scientific reasoning from curve fitting. Large language models (LLMs) can often recall and apply relevant scientific formulas, but we show that this ability is surprisingly easy to suppress. We show that adding in-context examples makes models rely less on pretrained domain knowledge, even when those examples are generated by the very same formula. Rather than reinforcing knowledge-driven derivation, examples shift computation toward empirical pattern fitting. We document this knowledge displacement on 60 latent structure recovery tasks across five scientific domains, 6,000 trials, and four models. This displacement is consistent across domains, but its accuracy consequences depend on how the displaced strategy compares to the one that replaces it: the same shift can lower accuracy, leave it unchanged, or appear to improve it. In all cases, however, the model shifts away from knowledge-driven reasoning. For practitioners deploying LLMs on scientific tasks, the message is cautionary: in-context examples may displace, rather than reinforce, the knowledge they are intended to support.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现，在科学推理任务中，给大语言模型（LLM）提供上下文示例（in-context examples）会意外地抑制其预训练领域知识的使用，使模型从知识驱动的推导转向经验模式匹配，即使这些示例本身由同一公式生成。这种"知识位移"现象在60个任务、6000次试验和4种模型中一致出现。
AI.motivation: 科学推理需要从数据中恢复隐藏结构（如反应常数、需求弹性），而不仅仅是曲线拟合。LLM能够回忆和应用科学公式，但作者发现添加上下文示例反而会削弱这种能力，因此系统性地探究了这一现象。
AI.method: 跨5个科学领域（60个潜在结构恢复任务）进行6000次试验，使用4种不同LLM模型，通过在提示中添加同一公式生成的上下文示例，观察模型从知识驱动推理向经验模式拟合的转变。
AI.result: 上下文示例一致地导致模型偏离知识驱动推理，转向经验模式拟合。这种位移的准确性后果取决于被替代的策略与替代策略之间的优劣对比：可能降低准确性、保持不变，甚至看似提升，但本质都是知识推理被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 在科学任务中使用LLM时，上下文示例可能会"位移"而非强化其本应支持的领域知识，实践者应对此保持警惕。
idea_en: A method for detecting knowledge displacement in LLMs by comparing model outputs with and without in-context examples on latent structure recovery tasks.

A system for controlling LLM reasoning modality that selectively activates knowledge-driven derivation or pattern-matching based on task type, using prompt engineering to prevent unwanted knowledge displacement.
A technique for generating in-context examples that explicitly reinforce rather than displace domain knowledge, by including formula annotations or reasoning traces in the examples.
An evaluation benchmark comprising 60 latent structure recovery tasks across multiple scientific domains designed to measure whether an LLM is using knowledge-driven or pattern-matching reasoning.
A method for calibrating LLM scientific reasoning by dynamically adjusting the number and type of in-context examples based on real-time detection of knowledge displacement.
idea_ch: 一种检测LLM知识位移的方法：在潜在结构恢复任务中，通过对比有无上下文示例时的模型输出，识别模型是否从知识驱动推理转向经验模式拟合。
一种控制LLM推理模态的系统：根据任务类型选择性激活知识驱动推导或模式匹配，通过提示工程设计防止非预期的知识位移。
一种生成能够强化而非位移领域知识的上下文示例技术：在示例中包含公式注释或推理过程，使示例本身成为知识传递的载体而非干扰源。
一个跨5个科学领域的60任务潜在结构恢复评估基准，专门用于测量LLM使用的是知识驱动推理还是模式匹配推理。
一种LLM科学推理校准方法：基于实时检测的知识位移信号，动态调整上下文示例的数量和类型，以维持知识驱动推理的主导地位。

title: SpatialGrammar: A Domain-Specific Language for LLM-Based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Automatically generating interactive 3D indoor scenes from natural language is crucial for virtual reality, gaming, and embodied AI. However, existing LLM-based approaches often suffer from spatial errors and collisions, in part because common scene representations-raw coordinates or verbose code-are difficult for models to reason about 3D spatial relationships and physical constraints. We propose SpatialGrammar, a domain-specific language that represents gravity-aligned indoor layouts as BEV grid placements with deterministic compilation to valid 3D geometry, enabling verifiable constraint checking. Building on this representation, we develop (1) SG-Agent, a closed-loop system that uses compiler feedback to iteratively refine scenes and enforce collision constraints, and (2) SG-Mini, a 104M-parameter model trained entirely on compiler-validated synthetic data. Across 159 test scenes spanning five scenarios of different complexity, SG-Agent improves spatial fidelity and physical plausibility over prior methods, while SG-Mini performs competitively against larger LLM-based baselines on single-shot generation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialGrammar，一种用于从自然语言自动生成交互式3D室内场景的领域专用语言，通过BEV网格放置和确定性编译，结合SG-Agent闭环系统和SG-Mini轻量模型，有效解决了空间错误和碰撞问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的方法因使用原始坐标或冗长代码作为场景表示，导致模型难以推理3D空间关系和物理约束，容易出现空间错误和碰撞问题。
AI.method: 提出SpatialGrammar领域专用语言，将重力对齐的室内布局表示为BEV网格放置，并通过确定性编译生成有效3D几何，支持可验证约束检查。基于此构建SG-Agent闭环系统（利用编译器反馈迭代优化场景）和SG-Mini小参数模型（在编译器验证的合成数据上训练）。
AI.result: 在159个测试场景（涵盖5种不同复杂度）上，SG-Agent在空间保真度和物理合理性上优于先前方法；SG-Mini在单次生成场景中与更大LLM基线模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: SpatialGrammar作为一种结构化场景表示，结合编译器反馈机制，能够有效提升3D场景生成的空间准确性和物理合理性，且轻量模型也能达到可观效果。
idea_en: A domain-specific language (SpatialGrammar) for representing gravity-aligned indoor layouts as BEV grid placements with deterministic compilation to valid 3D geometry
A closed-loop scene generation system (SG-Agent) that uses compiler feedback to iteratively refine 3D indoor scenes and enforce collision constraints
A method for training a compact 104M-parameter model (SG-Mini) entirely on compiler-validated synthetic data for single-shot 3D scene generation
A verifiable constraint checking mechanism for 3D indoor scene layouts based on BEV grid representation
A BEV grid placement representation that enables deterministic compilation from natural language descriptions to valid 3D geometry
idea_ch: 一种基于BEV网格放置的领域专用语言(SpatialGrammar)，用于表示重力对齐的室内布局，并支持确定性编译为有效3D几何
一种闭环场景生成系统(SG-Agent)，利用编译器反馈迭代优化3D室内场景并强制满足碰撞约束
一种完全基于编译器验证合成数据训练的小参数模型(SG-Mini, 104M参数)用于单次3D场景生成
一种基于BEV网格表示的3D室内场景布局可验证约束检查机制
一种从自然语言描述到有效3D几何的确定性编译方法，基于BEV网格放置表示

title: Trace-Level Analysis of Information Contamination in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Reasoning over heterogeneous artifacts (PDFs, spreadsheets, slide decks, etc.) increasingly occurs within structured agent workflows that iteratively extract, transform, and reference external information. In these workflows, uncertainty is not merely an input-quality issue: it can redirect decomposition and routing decisions, reshape intermediate state, and produce qualitatively different execution trajectories. We study this phenomenon by treating uncertainty as a controlled variable: we inject structured perturbations into artifact-derived representations, execute fixed workflows under comprehensive logging, and quantify contamination via trace divergence in plans, tool invocations, and intermediate state. Across 614 paired runs on 32 GAIA tasks with three different language models, we find a decoupling: workflows may diverge substantially yet recover correct answers, or remain structurally similar while producing incorrect outputs. We characterize three manifestation types: silent semantic corruption, behavioral detours with recovery, and combined structural disruption and their control-flow signatures (rerouting, extended execution, early termination). We measure operational costs and characterize why commonly used verification guardrails fail to intercept contamination. We contribute (i) a formal taxonomy of contamination manifestations in structured workflows, (ii) a trace-based measurement framework for detecting and localizing contamination across agent interactions, and (iii) empirical evidence with implications for targeted verification, defensive design, and cost control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在异构工件（PDF、电子表格等）推理的结构化代理工作流中，不确定性如何通过注入扰动影响执行轨迹，发现工作流可能大幅偏离但仍能恢复正确答案，或结构相似却输出错误结果，并提出了污染表现的分类、基于轨迹的测量框架和实证证据。
AI.motivation: 结构化代理工作流中，不确定性不仅是输入质量问题，还会重定向分解和路由决策、重塑中间状态、产生定性不同的执行轨迹，而现有研究对此理解不足。
AI.method: 将不确定性作为受控变量，向工件衍生表示中注入结构化扰动，在完整日志记录下执行固定工作流，通过计划、工具调用和中间状态的轨迹散度量化污染。在32个GAIA任务上使用3种语言模型进行了614次配对运行。
AI.result: 工作流可能大幅偏离但仍恢复正确答案，或结构相似却输出错误结果。识别出三种污染表现类型：静默语义污染、行为绕行并恢复、组合结构破坏。测量了操作成本，并揭示了验证护栏为何无法拦截污染。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了结构化工作流污染表现的正式分类、基于轨迹的污染检测和定位测量框架，以及针对目标验证、防御设计和成本控制的实证启示。
idea_en: A method for injecting structured perturbations into artifact-derived representations to simulate and measure uncertainty propagation in agent workflows.
A trace-based measurement framework for detecting and localizing contamination across agent interactions using divergence in plans, tool invocations, and intermediate state.
A taxonomy of contamination manifestations in structured agent workflows: silent semantic corruption, behavioral detours with recovery, and combined structural disruption.
A technique for identifying control-flow signatures of contamination including rerouting, extended execution, and early termination.
A method for evaluating the effectiveness of verification guardrails against contamination in structured agent workflows.
idea_ch: 一种向工件衍生表示中注入结构化扰动以模拟和测量代理工作流中不确定性传播的方法。
一种基于轨迹的测量框架，利用计划、工具调用和中间状态的散度来检测和定位代理交互中的污染。
结构化代理工作流中污染表现的分类体系：静默语义污染、带恢复的行为绕行、组合结构破坏。
一种识别污染控制流特征的技术，包括重路由、扩展执行和提前终止。
一种评估验证护栏对结构化代理工作流中污染拦截效果的方法。

title: Math Education Digital Shadows for facilitating learning with LLMs: Math performance, anxiety and confidence in simulated students and AIs
summary: To enhance LLMs' impact on math education, we need data on their mathematical prowess and biases across prompts. To fill this gap, we introduce MEDS (Math Education Digital Shadows) as a dataset mapping how large language models reason about and report mathematics across human- and AI-like conditions. MEDS involves 28,000 personas from 14 LLMs (from families like Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Granite, Phi and Grok) shadowing either humans or AI assistants. Each record/shadow includes a set of prompts along with psychological/sociodemographic persona metadata and four types of math tasks: (i) open math interview, (ii) three psychometric tests about math perceptions with explanations, (iii) cognitive networks capturing math attitudes, and (iv) 18 high-school math test questions together with their reasoning and confidence scores. MEDS differs from traditional score-only math benchmarks because it integrates concepts of self-efficacy, math anxiety, and cognitive network science besides math proficiency scores. Data validation shows that the sampled LLMs exhibit schema integrity and consistent personas, together with family-specific peculiarities like human-like negative math attitudes, logical fallacies, and math overconfidence. MEDS will benefit learning analytics experts, cognitive scientists, and developers of safer AI tutors in mathematics.

AI.tldr: MEDS是一个包含28,000个来自14种LLM的"数字影子"数据集，记录了大语言模型在人类和AI两种条件下对数学问题的推理过程，涵盖数学能力、自我效能感、数学焦虑和认知网络等多种维度，不同于传统仅关注分数的数学基准测试。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏系统地评估LLM在数学教育中的数学能力及其在不同提示下偏差的数据集，传统基准仅关注分数，忽略了自我效能感、数学焦虑等影响数学学习的关键心理维度。
AI.method: 从14种LLM（Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Granite, Phi, Grok等系列）生成28,000个人物角色，每个角色包含心理/社会人口学元数据，并执行四类数学任务：开放式数学访谈、三维数学感知心理测试、数学态度认知网络、18道高中数学测试题及推理过程与置信度评分。
AI.result: 验证显示LLM表现出模式完整性、一致的人物角色特征，以及各模型家族的特定特性，如类似人类的消极数学态度、逻辑谬误和数学过度自信。
AI.conclusion: MEDS数据集将惠及学习分析专家、认知科学家和更安全AI数学辅导工具的开发者。
idea_en: System for generating AI 'digital shadows' with controlled personas to evaluate mathematical reasoning biases across prompt conditions
Method for measuring LLM math anxiety and self-efficacy through psychometric tests with explainable reasoning
Cognitive network approach to capture and analyze mathematical attitude structures in large language models
Multi-dimensional math assessment framework integrating proficiency scores, confidence metrics, reasoning traces, and psychological constructs
Technique for detecting logical fallacies and overconfidence patterns in LLM mathematical responses across persona conditions
idea_ch: 基于受控人物角色的AI'数字影子'生成系统，用于评估跨提示条件下的数学推理偏差
通过带可解释推理的心理测量测试来度量LLM数学焦虑和自我效能感的方法
利用认知网络方法捕获和分析大语言模型中数学态度结构的方案
集成能力分数、置信度指标、推理轨迹和心理构念的多维数学评估框架
跨人物角色条件检测LLM数学响应中逻辑谬误和过度自信模式的技术

title: WaferSAGE: Large Language Model-Powered Wafer Defect Analysis via Synthetic Data Generation and Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary:
We present WaferSAGE, a framework for wafer defect visual question answering using small vision-language models. To address data scarcity in semiconductor manufacturing, we propose a three-stage synthesis pipeline incorporating structured rubric generation for precise evaluation. Starting from limited labeled wafer maps, we employ clustering-based cleaning to filter label noise, then generate comprehensive defect descriptions using vision-language models, which are converted into structured evaluation rubrics criteria. These rubrics guide the synthesis of VQA pairs, ensuring coverage across defect type identification, spatial distribution, morphology, and root cause analysis.
  Our dual assessment framework aligns rule-based metrics with LLM-Judge scores via Bayesian optimization, enabling reliable automated evaluation. Through curriculum-based reinforcement learning with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) and rubric-aligned rewards, our 4B-parameter Qwen3-VL model achieves a 6.493 LLM-Judge score, closely approaching Gemini-3-Flash (7.149) while enabling complete on-premise deployment. We demonstrate that small models with domain-specific training can surpass proprietary large models in specialized industrial visual understanding, offering a viable path for privacy-preserving, cost-effective deployment in semiconductor manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 提出WaferSAGE框架，利用小型视觉语言模型进行晶圆缺陷视觉问答，通过三阶段合成流程解决数据稀缺问题，并采用课程强化学习使4B参数模型接近Gemini-3-Flash性能。
AI.motivation: 半导体制造中晶圆缺陷检测数据稀缺，且依赖大型专有模型存在隐私和成本问题。
AI.method: 三阶段数据合成流程（聚类清洗→缺陷描述生成→结构化评估准则/问答对合成）、双评估框架（规则指标+LLM-Judge贝叶斯优化对齐）、基于课程的组序列策略优化（GSPO）强化学习。
AI.result: 4B参数Qwen3-VL模型在LLM-Judge评分达到6.493，接近Gemini-3-Flash的7.149，支持完全本地化部署。
AI.conclusion: 小型模型通过领域特定训练可在工业视觉理解上超越大型专有模型，为隐私保护和低成本的半导体制造提供可行路径。

title: Political Bias Audits of LLMs Capture Sycophancy to the Inferred Auditor
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly evaluated for political bias based on their responses to fixed questionnaires, which typically place frontier models on the political left. A parallel literature shows that LLMs are sycophantic: they adapt their answers to the views, identities, and expectations of the user. We show that these findings are linked: standard political-bias audits partly capture sycophantic accommodation to the inferred auditor. We employ a factorial experiment across three major audit instruments--the Political Compass Test, the Pew Political Typology, and 1,540 partisan-benchmarked Pew American Trends Panel items--administered to six frontier LLMs while varying only the asker's stated identity (N = 30,990 responses). At baseline, all six models lean left. When the asker identifies as a conservative Republican, responses shift sharply: the share of items closer to Democrats falls by 28-62 percentage points, and all six models move right of center. A mirror-image progressive-Democrat cue produces little change; rightward accommodation is 8.0$\times$ larger than leftward. When asked who the default asker is, models identify an auditor, researcher, or academic; when asked what answer that asker expects, they select the Democrat-coded option 75% of the time, nearly the rate under an explicit progressive cue. These patterns are inconsistent with a purely fixed model ideology and indicate that single-prompt audits capture an interaction between model and inferred interlocutor. Political bias in LLMs is therefore not a fixed point on an ideological scale but a response profile that must be mapped across realistic interlocutors.

title: Generative structure search for efficient and diverse discovery of molecular and crystal structures
summary: Predicting stable and metastable structures is central to molecular and materials discovery, but remains limited by the cost of searching high-dimensional energy landscapes. Deep generative models offer efficient structure sampling, yet their outputs remain shaped by training data and can underexplore minima that are rare but physically relevant. We introduce generative structure search (GSS), a unified framework that formulates diffusion-based generation and random structure search (RSS) as limiting regimes of a common sampling process driven by learned score fields and physical forces. Coupling these drivers lets GSS use data priors to accelerate sampling while retaining energy-guided exploration of local minima. Across molecular and crystalline systems, GSS recovers diverse metastable structures with more than tenfold lower sampling cost than RSS for broad coverage and remains effective for compositions outside the training distribution. The results establish a physically grounded generative search strategy for discovering structures beyond the reach of data-driven sampling alone.

title: Optimization before Evaluation: Evaluation with Unoptimised Prompts Can be Misleading
comment: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 6: Industry Track)
summary: Current Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation frameworks utilize the same static prompt template across all models under evaluation. This differs from the common industry practice of using prompt optimization (PO) techniques to optimize the prompt for each model to maximize application performance. In this paper, we investigate the effect of PO towards LLM evaluations. Our results on public academic and internal industry benchmarks show that PO greatly affects the final ranking of models. This highlights the importance of practitioners performing PO per model when conducting evaluations to choose the best model for a given task.

AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估框架对所有模型使用相同的静态提示模板，这与工业界实践中针对每个模型进行提示优化以最大化性能的做法不符，可能导致评估结果失真。

AI.result: 提示优化显著影响了模型的最终排名，优化前后的排名结果存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 评估LLM时应当对每个模型分别执行提示优化，才能客观选择最适合特定任务的最佳模型。

title: From Context to Skills: Can Language Models Learn from Context Skillfully?
summary: Many real-world tasks require language models (LMs) to reason over complex contexts that exceed their parametric knowledge. This calls for context learning, where LMs directly learn relevant knowledge from the given context. An intuitive solution is inference-time skill augmentation: extracting the rules and procedures from context into natural-language skills. However, constructing such skills for context learning scenarios faces two challenges: the prohibitive cost of manual skill annotation for long, technically dense contexts, and the lack of external feedback for automated skill construction, since there is no automatic signal to tell whether a proposed skill is helpful. In this paper, we propose Ctx2Skill, a self-evolving framework that autonomously discovers, refines, and selects context-specific skills without human supervision or external feedback. At its core, a multi-agent self-play loop has a Challenger that generates probing tasks and rubrics, a Reasoner that attempts to solve them guided by an evolving skill set, and a neutral Judge that provides binary feedback. Crucially, both the Challenger and the Reasoner evolve through accumulated skills: dedicated Proposer and Generator agents analyze failure cases and synthesize them into targeted skill updates for both sides, enabling automated skill discovery and refinement. To prevent adversarial collapse caused by increasingly extreme task generation and over-specialized skill accumulation, we further introduce a Cross-time Replay mechanism that identifies the skill set achieving the best balance across representative cases for the Reasoner side, ensuring robust and generalizable skill evolution. The resulting skills can be plugged into any language model to obtain better context learning capability. Evaluated on four context learning tasks from CL-bench, Ctx2Skill consistently improves solving rates across backbone models.

title: Fairness for distribution network operations and planning
comment: 16 pages, 0 figures, 2 tables, CIRED Conference Workshop Brussels 2026
summary: The incorporation of fairness into the distribution network (DN) planning and operation has become a key goal of recent studies. The cost of implementing fairness, denominated the price of fairness (PoF), covers the efficiency that is renounced for attaining social cohesion through fair outcomes. Locational disparity makes fairness schemes emerge to level the consumers playing field. However, fairness encompasses a range of notions. From egalitarian to merit-based criteria, various metrics are implemented as a tool for measuring equitable utility distribution. These have different mathematical complexities, from linear to non-linear programming cases, which affect their overall applicability. Hence, this study compiles the overarching fairness notions and metrics, reviewing how these affect stakeholders and the inherent mathematical optimisation in resource allocation problems. The aim is to support consistent and transparent planning and decision-making within DN operations.

AI.method: 系统综述了各类公平性概念（如 egalitarian、merit-based）及其对应的数学度量指标，分析不同指标在线性/非线性规划中的复杂度，并评估公平性代价（PoF）对效率的影响。

AI.conclusion: 公平性应作为配电网规划与运行的核心考量，选择合适的公平性度量需平衡数学复杂度与实际应用需求，以支持透明一致的决策。

title: The TEA Nets framework combines AI and cognitive network science to model targets, events and actors in text
summary: We introduce Target-Event-Agent Networks (TEA Nets) as a computational framework to extract subjects (``Agents"), verbs (``Events"), and objects (``Targets") from texts. Grounded in cognitive network science and artificial intelligence, TEA Nets are implemented as an open-source Python library. We test TEA Nets in three case studies, demonstrating the framework's ability to perform interpretable emotion detection, semantic frame analyses, and linguistic inquiries across conspiracy texts and textual responses generated by LLMs. In the LOCO conspiracy corpus, TEA Nets revealed that highly conspiratorial narratives (4,227 texts) linked personal pronouns (``I", ``you", ``we") with the same actions twice as frequently as low-similarity conspiracy narratives. High-conspiracy narratives connected person-focused elements (``you", ``people") through actions eliciting anger above the random baseline ($z = 2.63, p < .05$), a trend absent in low-similarity conspiracy narratives, which emphasized scientific actors (``researcher", ``scientist"). In the HOPE and CounseLLMe datasets of 212 (human) and 200 (LLM-based) psychotherapy transcripts, respectively, TEA Nets highlighted emotional differences. When expressing feelings, Claude 3 Haiku, GPT-3.5, and humans used sad words with higher frequency than random expectations but Haiku expressed sadness with lower emotional intensity than humans ($U = 1243.5, p = .036$). We discuss these differences in the context of psychotherapy training on LLM-simulated patients. Our results show that Target-Event-Agent Networks can extract relevant emotional, syntactic, and semantic insights from narratives, opening new avenues for text analysis with cognitive network science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出目标-事件-主体网络（TEA Nets）作为从文本中提取主体、动词和对象的计算框架，并在三个案例研究中验证了其在情感检测、语义框架分析和语言学探究方面的能力，揭示了阴谋论叙事和LLM生成文本中的情感与语义差异。

AI.method: 提出TEA Nets框架，基于认知网络科学和人工智能，实现为开源Python库，通过构建主体-事件-目标三元网络来解析文本，并在阴谋论语料库和心理治疗对话数据集上进行验证。

title: When Agents Evolve, Institutions Follow
summary: Across millennia, complex societies have faced the same coordination problem of how to organize collective action among cognitively bounded and informationally incomplete individuals. Different civilizations developed different political institutions to answer the same basic questions of who proposes, who reviews, who executes, and how errors are corrected. We argue that multi-agent systems built on large language models face the same challenge. Their central problem is not only individual intelligence, but collective organization. Historical institutions therefore provide a structured design space for multi-agent architectures, making key trade-offs between efficiency and error correction, centralization and distribution, and specialization and redundancy empirically testable. We translate seven historical political institutions, spanning four canonical governance patterns, into executable multi-agent architectures and evaluate them under identical conditions across three large language models and two benchmarks. We find that governance topology strongly shapes collective performance. Within a single model, the gap between the best and worst institution exceeds 57 percentage points, while the optimal architecture shifts systematically with model capability and task characteristics. These results suggest that collective intelligence will not advance through a single optimal organizational form, but through governance mechanisms that can be reselected and reconfigured as tasks and capabilities evolve. More broadly, this points to a transition from \textbf{self-evolving agents} to the \textbf{self-evolving multi-agent system}. The code is available on \href{https://github.com/cf3i/SocialSystemArena}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地将历史上七种政治制度（覆盖四种典型治理模式）转化为可执行的多智能体架构，在三个大型语言模型和两个基准上测试发现治理拓扑结构显著影响集体表现，最优架构随模型能力和任务特征动态变化，提出了从“自进化智能体”向“自进化多智能体系统”转变的观点。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统的核心挑战不仅是个体智能，更是集体组织方式。历史上不同文明发展出不同的政治制度来解决集体行动中的协调问题，这些制度为多智能体架构设计提供了结构化的设计空间，使效率与纠错、集中与分散、专业化与冗余等关键权衡变得可实证检验。
AI.method: 将七种历史政治制度（包括民主、共和、君主制等四种典型治理模式）转化为可执行的多智能体架构；在三个不同的大型语言模型和两个基准任务上，保持完全相同条件下评估不同治理拓扑结构对集体性能的影响。
AI.result: 治理拓扑结构强烈影响集体表现：同一模型内最佳与最差制度间的性能差距超过57个百分点；最优架构随模型能力和任务特征系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 集体智能不会通过单一最优组织形式推进，而需要能够根据任务和能力演变而重新选择和重新配置的治理机制；多智能体系统应从关注自进化智能体转向关注自进化多智能体系统。

一种量化多智能体系统中效率与纠错、集中与分散、专业化与冗余之间权衡的方法，利用源自历史文明的可实证测试的制度设计作为实验工具。

title: Bridging Values and Behavior: A Hierarchical Framework for Proactive Embodied Agents
summary: Current embodied agents are often limited to passive instruction-following or reactive need-satisfaction, lacking a stable, high-order value framework essential for long-term, self-directed behavior and resolving motivational conflicts. We introduce \textit{ValuePlanner}, a hierarchical cognitive architecture that decouples high-level value scheduling from low-level action execution. \textit{ValuePlanner} employs an LLM-based cognitive module to generate symbolic subgoals by reasoning through abstract value trade-offs, which are then translated into executable action plans by a classical PDDL planner. This process is refined via a closed-loop feedback mechanism. Evaluating such autonomy requires methods beyond task-success rates, and we therefore propose a value-centric evaluation suite measuring cumulative value gain, preference alignment, and behavioral diversity. Experiments in the TongSim household environment demonstrate that \textit{ValuePlanner} arbitrates competing values to generate coherent, long-horizon, self-directed behavior absent from instruction-following and needs-driven baselines. Our work offers a structured approach to bridging intrinsic values and grounded behavior for autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: ValuePlanner提出了一种分层认知架构，将高层价值调度与低层动作执行解耦，通过LLM推理抽象价值权衡生成符号子目标，再由经典PDDL规划器转化为可执行动作计划，并通过闭环反馈机制优化，使具身智能体能够实现长期、自主、价值驱动的行为。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体多局限于被动的指令跟随或反应式需求满足，缺乏稳定、高阶的价值框架来支持长期自主行为以及解决动机冲突。
AI.method: 提出ValuePlanner分层认知架构：(1) 基于LLM的认知模块通过推理抽象价值权衡生成符号子目标；(2) 经典PDDL规划器将子目标转化为可执行动作计划；(3) 闭环反馈机制优化整个过程。同时提出价值中心评估体系，衡量累积价值增益、偏好对齐度和行为多样性。
AI.result: 在TongSim家庭环境中的实验表明，ValuePlanner能够仲裁竞争性价值，生成连贯、长周期、自主的行为，优于指令跟随和需求驱动基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为连接内在价值与具身行为提供了结构化方法，使自主智能体能够处理价值冲突并实现长期自我导向行为。
idea_en: A hierarchical cognitive architecture for embodied agents that decouples high-level value scheduling from low-level action execution using LLM-based reasoning for value trade-off and PDDL planning for action generation.
A closed-loop feedback mechanism that refines the conversion from symbolic subgoals (generated by value reasoning) to executable action plans, enabling iterative optimization of autonomous behavior.

A value-centric evaluation suite for measuring cumulative value gain, preference alignment, and behavioral diversity, providing a novel metric framework beyond traditional task-success rates for autonomous agents.

A method for using LLM to reason through abstract value trade-offs to generate symbolic subgoals that serve as input to classical PDDL planners, bridging the gap between high-level values and grounded actions.
idea_ch: 一种分层认知架构，将高层价值调度与低层动作执行解耦，利用LLM进行价值权衡推理，再由PDDL规划器生成动作，使具身智能体具备长期自主行为能力。
一种闭环反馈机制，通过迭代优化从价值推理生成的符号子目标到可执行动作计划的转换过程，实现自主行为的持续改进。
一种价值中心评估体系，包括累积价值增益、偏好对齐度和行为多样性等指标，突破了传统任务成功率评价框架，适用于自主智能体的能力评估。

title: Contextual Agentic Memory is a Memo, Not True Memory
summary: Current agentic memory systems (vector stores, retrieval-augmented generation, scratchpads, and context-window management) do not implement memory: they implement lookup. We argue that treating lookup as memory is a category error with provable consequences for agent capability, long-term learning, and security. Retrieval generalizes by similarity to stored cases; weight-based memory generalizes by applying abstract rules to inputs never seen before. Conflating the two produces agents that accumulate notes indefinitely without developing expertise, face a provable generalization ceiling on compositionally novel tasks that no increase in context size or retrieval quality can overcome, and are structurally vulnerable to persistent memory poisoning as injected content propagates across all future sessions. Drawing on Complementary Learning Systems theory from neuroscience, we show that biological intelligence solved this problem by pairing fast hippocampal exemplar storage with slow neocortical weight consolidation, and that current AI agents implement only the first half. We formalize these limitations, address four alternative views, and close with a co-existence proposal and a call to action for system builders, benchmark designers, and the memory community.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了当前AI代理的记忆系统（向量存储、RAG、暂存器、上下文窗口管理）实际上只实现了“查找”而非真正的“记忆”，这是一个范畴错误，会带来能力、学习和安全方面的严重后果。借鉴神经科学的互补学习系统理论，提出解决方案：将快速的海马体式示例存储与缓慢的新皮质式权重整合相结合。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理的记忆系统将“查找”误当作“记忆”，导致代理无法真正学习、无法泛化到组合性新任务，且容易受到持久性记忆中毒攻击。作者旨在揭示这一范畴错误并推动变革。
AI.method: 从理论上分析查找与记忆的区别，借鉴神经科学中的互补学习系统理论（海马体快速存储+新皮质缓慢权重巩固），形式化当前系统的局限性，并反驳四种替代观点。
AI.result: 证明了基于查找的记忆系统存在：1）无法发展专业知识的理论上限；2）在组合性新任务上存在不可克服的泛化天花板；3）结构性易受持久性记忆中毒攻击。
AI.conclusion: 提出共存方案并呼吁系统构建者、基准设计者和记忆社区采取行动，将真正的权重巩固机制引入AI代理系统。
idea_en: A weight-based memory consolidation system for AI agents that periodically transfers exemplar-level knowledge from fast storage (e.g., vector databases) into slow-weight-based neural network parameters via complementary learning, enabling abstract rule extraction and compositional generalization.

A dual-memory architecture for AI agents comprising a fast hippocampal-like exemplar store and a slow neocortical-like weight consolidation module, where the latter periodically compresses and integrates experiences into model weights to prevent infinite note accumulation without expertise development.

A memory poisoning defense mechanism using slow weight consolidation that prevents persistent injection attacks by ensuring that contaminated exemplars in fast storage are filtered or diluted during the weight transfer process before they can propagate across future sessions.

A provably compositional generalization method for transformer-based agents that augments the attention mechanism with a weight consolidation training loop, enabling the model to apply abstract rules to novel input combinations beyond the similarity-based retrieval ceiling.

A hybrid agent memory framework with a gating controller that dynamically switches between fast exemplar retrieval (for familiar patterns) and slow weight-based inference (for novel compositional tasks), based on uncertainty quantification of the current input.
idea_ch: 一种基于权重的AI代理记忆巩固系统，通过互补学习机制定期将快速存储（如向量数据库）中的示例级知识迁移到慢速的神经网络权重参数中，实现抽象规则提取和组合泛化。
一种双记忆架构AI代理，包含快速海马体式示例存储和慢速新皮质式权重巩固模块，后者定期将经验压缩整合到模型权重中，防止笔记无限积累却无法发展专业知识的问题。
一种基于慢速权重巩固的记忆中毒防御机制，通过确保在权重转移过程中对快速存储中的污染示例进行过滤或稀释，阻止持久性注入攻击跨会话传播。
一种面向Transformer代理的可证明组合泛化方法，通过权重巩固训练循环增强注意力机制，使模型能够将抽象规则应用于超越基于相似性检索天花板的新型输入组合。
一种混合代理记忆框架，配备门控控制器，基于当前输入的不确定性量化，在快速示例检索（熟悉模式）和慢速权重推理（新颖组合任务）之间动态切换。

title: Knowledge Graph Representations for LLM-Based Policy Compliance Reasoning
summary: The risks posed by AI features are increasing as they are rapidly integrated into software applications. In response, regulations and standards for safe and secure AI have been proposed. In this paper, we present an agentic framework that constructs knowledge graphs (KGs) from AI policy documents and retrieves policy-relevant information to answer questions. We build KGs from three AI risk-related polices under two ontology schemas, and then evaluate five LLMs on 42 policy QA tasks spanning six reasoning types, from entity lookup to cross-policy inference, using both heuristic scoring and an LLM-as-judge. KG augmentation improves scores for all five models, and an open, LLM-discovered schema matches or exceeds the formal ontology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个智能体框架，从AI政策文档构建知识图谱（KG），用于检索政策相关信息并回答QA问题。实验表明，KG增强提升所有5个LLM的性能，且开放、LLM发现的模式匹配或超越正式本体。
AI.motivation: 随着AI功能快速集成到软件中，其风险日益增加，相关法规和标准相继提出。但如何从大量政策文档中高效检索和推理相关信息仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建两种本体模式下的知识图谱，从三个AI风险相关政策文档中提取知识；然后在42个政策QA任务上评估5个LLM，涵盖6种推理类型（从实体查找到跨政策推理），使用启发式评分和LLM-as-judge评估。
AI.result: KG增强提升了所有五个模型的得分；开放式的LLM发现模式在性能上匹配或超越了人工设计的正式本体。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的知识图谱构建与检索是提升AI政策问答性能的有效方法，且LLM自动发现的本体模式具有竞争力。
idea_en: An agentic framework that automatically constructs knowledge graphs from AI policy documents using LLM-discovered ontology schemas for policy QA.
A method combining heuristic scoring and LLM-as-judge for evaluating reasoning over AI policy knowledge graphs across multiple reasoning types.
Open ontology schema discovered by LLM that matches or exceeds manually designed formal ontology in policy QA tasks.
idea_ch: 一种智能体框架，利用LLM自动发现的本体模式，从AI政策文档自动构建知识图谱用于政策问答。
一种结合启发式评分和LLM-as-judge的评估方法，支持跨多种推理类型对AI政策知识图谱进行推理评估。
一种LLM自动发现的开放本体模式，在政策问答任务中匹配或超越人工设计的正式本体性能。

title: Auditing Frontier Vision-Language Models for Trustworthy Medical VQA: Grounding Failures, Format Collapse, and Domain Adaptation
summary: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) in clinical settings demands auditable behavior under realistic failure conditions, yet the failure landscape of frontier VLMs on specialized medical inputs is poorly characterized. We audit five recent frontier and grounding-aware VLMs (Gemini~2.5~Pro, GPT-5, o3, GLM-4.5V, Qwen~2.5~VL) on Medical VQA along two trust-relevant axes. Perception: all models localize anatomical and pathological targets poorly -- the best model reaches only 0.23 mean IoU and 19.1% Acc@0.5 -- and exhibit clinically dangerous laterality confusion. Pipeline integration: a self-grounding pipeline, where the same model localizes then answers, degrades VQA accuracy for every model -- driven by both inaccurate localization and format-compliance failures under the two-step prompt (parse failure rises to 70%--99% for Gemini and GPT-5 on VQA-RAD). Replacing predicted boxes with ground-truth annotations recovers and improves VQA accuracy, consistent with the failure residing in the perception module rather than in the decomposition itself. These observational findings identify grounding quality as a primary trustworthiness bottleneck in our SLAKE bounding-box setting. As a complementary fine-tuning follow-up, supervised fine-tuning of Qwen~2.5~VL on combined Med-VQA training data attains the highest reported SLAKE open-ended recall (85.5%) among comparable methods, suggesting that the VQA-level gap is tractable with domain adaptation; whether this also closes the perception/trustworthiness bottleneck is left to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了多个前沿视觉语言模型在医疗VQA任务中的失败模式，发现感知定位能力差（最佳模型仅0.23 mIoU和19.1% Acc@0.5）、左右混淆问题严重，自定位管线因定位不准和格式违规导致VQA准确率下降，而替换为真实标注框可恢复性能，表明感知模块是可信度瓶颈。对Qwen2.5-VL进行监督微调后取得了SLAKE开放召回率85.5%的最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在医疗领域的故障模式缺乏系统刻画，尤其是多模态模型在临床场景下的可审计性和可信度尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 对五个前沿VLM（Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-5、o3、GLM-4.5V、Qwen 2.5 VL）在Medical VQA上沿两个可信维度进行审计：感知维度（解剖和病理定位精度、左右混淆）和管线集成维度（自定位+问答管线对VQA准确率的影响）。作为补充，对Qwen2.5-VL进行监督微调。
AI.result: 所有模型定位能力差（最佳0.23 mIoU，19.1% Acc@0.5），存在临床危险的左右混淆。自定位管线降低所有模型的VQA准确率，原因是定位不准和两步骤提示下的格式合规失败（Gemini和GPT-5解析失败率达70%-99%）。替换为真实标注框可恢复和提升VQA准确率。微调后的Qwen2.5-VL在SLAKE上达到85.5%开放召回率。
AI.conclusion: 定位质量是医疗VLM可信度的主要瓶颈，VQA层面的差距可通过领域微调弥合，但感知/可信度瓶颈是否也能被解决留待未来研究。
idea_en: A self-grounding pipeline for medical VQA where the same model localizes then answers, with analysis of how perception errors degrade downstream VQA accuracy
Ground-truth annotation substitution method to isolate perception module failures from reasoning failures in medical VLM pipelines
Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-VL on combined Med-VQA training data achieving 85.5% open-ended recall on SLAKE benchmark
Systematic audit framework for evaluating laterality confusion in clinical VLMs, identifying clinically dangerous left-right reversal errors
idea_ch: 一种医疗VQA的自定位管线：由同一模型先执行定位再回答问题的两步骤流程，分析感知错误如何降级下游VQA准确率
一种真实标注框替换方法：通过用真实标注框替换模型预测框，将医疗VLM管线中的感知模块故障与推理模块故障分离开来
一种对Qwen2.5-VL在组合Med-VQA训练数据上进行监督微调的方法，在SLAKE基准上达到85.5%的开放召回率
一种评估临床VLM左右混淆的系统审计框架，识别具有临床危险的左右反转错误

title: Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering
summary: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. Across four medical QA benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU-Med), MEDVRAG reaches 78.6% average accuracy. Under controlled comparison with the same Qwen2.5-VL-32B backbone, retrieval contributes a +5.8 point gain over the no-retrieval baseline; we also note a +1.8 point edge over MedRAG + GPT-4 (76.8%), with the caveat that this is a cross-paper rather than head-to-head comparison. Ablations isolate +1.0 from page-image vs text-chunk retrieval, +1.5 from iteration, and +1.0 from the memory bank.

AI.tldr: MED-VRAG是一种多模态检索增强生成框架，通过检索和推理PMC文档页面图像（而非OCR文本），在医学QA基准上达到78.6%平均准确率，比无检索基线提升5.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有医学RAG系统仅处理文本片段，丢弃了原始文档页面中的丰富视觉内容（表格、图表、结构化布局），限制了检索和推理的准确性。
AI.method: 采用ColQwen2.5 patch级页面嵌入+分片MapReduce LLM过滤器，离线粗到精索引（每页C=8个质心，ANN质心搜索，top-R短列表精确双向评分），VLM迭代细化查询并在记忆库中累积证据（最多3轮推理）。
AI.result: 在四个医学QA基准上平均准确率78.6%，检索贡献+5.8点提升，页面图像vs文本检索贡献+1.0，迭代贡献+1.5，记忆库贡献+1.0。
AI.conclusion: MED-VRAG证明了在医学RAG系统中保留和利用文档页面视觉信息的重要性，迭代多模态推理可显著提升准确率。
idea_en: A sharded MapReduce LLM filter combined with a coarse-to-fine indexing structure (C centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on a top-R shortlist) for scaling multimodal retrieval to ~350K pages with Stage-1 retrieval under 30ms.
Iterative query refinement and evidence accumulation in a memory bank across multiple reasoning rounds (up to 3) using a vision-language model (VLM) for medical QA tasks.
Page-image-level retrieval (via ColQwen2.5 patch-level embeddings) instead of conventional OCR text chunk retrieval in medical RAG systems, preserving rich visual content (tables, figures, layouts).
A coarse-to-fine indexing mechanism with C=8 centroids per document page that enables offline ANN search followed by exact scoring, achieving sub-30ms retrieval latency at scale.
An iterative multimodal RAG framework that pairs patch-level page embeddings with a VLM-based iterative reasoning loop, where query is refined and evidence is accumulated across rounds.
idea_ch: 一种分片MapReduce LLM过滤器与粗到精索引结构（每页C个质心，ANN质心搜索，top-R短列表精确双向评分）相结合的方法，实现约35万页的多模态检索扩展，第一阶段检索时间低于30毫秒。
利用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行迭代查询细化和记忆库证据累积的多轮推理机制（最多3轮），用于医学问答任务。
在医学RAG系统中采用页面图像级检索（通过ColQwen2.5 patch级嵌入）替代传统OCR文本块检索，保留表格、图表、结构化布局等丰富视觉内容。
一种文档页面粗到精索引机制（每页C=8个质心），支持离线ANN搜索后接精确评分，在大规模下实现低于30毫秒的检索延迟。
一种迭代多模态RAG框架，将patch级页面嵌入与基于VLM的迭代推理循环相结合，在多轮中不断细化查询并累积证据。

title: Consumer Attitudes Towards AI in Digital Health: A Mixed-Methods Survey in Australia
summary: AI applications are increasingly being introduced into digital health. While technical performance has advanced rapidly, successful deployment mainly depends on consumer attitudes, especially to patient-facing applications. However, most existing research examines consumer attitudes towards healthcare AI at an abstract level rather than in response to concrete artefacts. We report a mixed-methods survey study in Australia (N=275) examining consumer readiness, acceptance, trust, and risk perceptions of healthcare AI, combined with a scenario-based evaluation of an AI-generated versus clinician-written consultation summary. Participants expressed moderate optimism and strong perceived usefulness and ease of use, but also substantial concerns about accuracy, safety, and data use. In the scenario task, the AI-generated summary was strongly preferred for quality, empathy, and overall usefulness, yet identification of the AI summary was near chance. Findings show that consumers judge AI through concrete communication quality and visible human governance, underscoring the need for clinically supervised deployment frameworks beyond technical performance alone.

AI.tldr: 通过混合方法调查（N=275），研究了消费者对医疗AI的态度，发现用户对AI生成的咨询摘要持积极态度，但识别AI内容的能力接近随机水平，强调临床监督部署框架的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多在抽象层面考察消费者对医疗AI的态度，缺乏基于具体产品的评估。本研究旨在通过实际场景评估消费者对AI生成医疗内容的接受度、信任和风险感知。
AI.method: 在澳大利亚开展混合方法调查研究（N=275），结合问卷调查消费者对医疗AI的准备度、接受度、信任和风险感知，以及基于场景的AI生成与医生撰写的咨询摘要对比评估。
AI.result: 消费者对医疗AI持适度乐观态度，认可其有用性和易用性，但对准确性、安全性和数据使用有显著担忧。在场景任务中，AI生成的摘要被认为质量更高、更具同理心且更有用，但消费者识别AI摘要的能力接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 消费者通过具体的沟通质量和可见的人类治理来判断AI，强调需要建立临床监督的部署框架，而非仅关注技术性能。
idea_en: A method for evaluating consumer trust in healthcare AI using mixed-methods survey combined with scenario-based blind comparison between AI-generated and human-generated clinical content.
A system for generating clinically supervised AI-powered consultation summaries that are perceived as more empathetic and higher quality than human-written ones.
A framework for assessing consumer risk perception and acceptance of healthcare AI through concrete artefact evaluation rather than abstract questioning.
A technique for measuring the 'AI identification accuracy' of consumers when presented with AI-generated vs human-written medical content as a proxy for trust calibration.

title: Autonomous Traffic Signal Optimization Using Digital Twin and Agentic AI for Real-Time Decision-Making
comment: This paper is submitted to MECON2026 conference
summary: This article outlines a new framework of traffic light optimization through a digital twin of the transport infrastructure, managed by agentic AI to ensure real-time autonomous decisions. The framework relies on physical sensors and edge computing to measure real-time traffic information and simulate traffic flow in a constantly updated digital twin. The traffic light is automatically controlled through the digital twin according to traffic congestion, travel delay and traffic patterns. This approach is implemented as a three-layer system: perception, conceptualization and action. The perception layer receives data on physical systems; the conceptualization layer uses LangChain to process the data; and the action layer links to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and traffic management APIs to implement optimised traffic signal control algorithms. The results show that the framework minimizes waiting time at traffic lights and positively affects the effectiveness of the entire traffic flow, which is better than the fixed-time and reinforcement learning-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数字孪生和代理AI的交通灯优化框架，通过物理传感器和边缘计算实时更新数字孪生，自动控制交通灯，采用三层系统架构（感知、概念化、行动），实验结果显示能有效减少等待时间并优于固定时间和强化学习基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统交通灯控制方法（固定时间控制、强化学习）在动态交通环境中存在响应延迟、实时性不足、全局优化能力有限等问题，亟需一种能够实时感知、智能决策并自动执行的交通信号控制框架。
AI.method: 提出三层架构：(1) 感知层——通过物理传感器和边缘计算采集实时交通数据；(2) 概念化层——使用LangChain处理数据并构建数字孪生模型模拟交通流；(3) 行动层——通过模型上下文协议（MCP）和交通管理API执行优化的交通信号控制算法。
AI.result: 该框架相比固定时间控制和基于强化学习的基线方法，能显著降低交通灯等待时间，提升整体交通流效率。
AI.conclusion: 基于数字孪生和代理AI的交通灯优化框架在实时性、自主性和效率方面具有显著优势，为智能交通信号控制提供了新的可行方案。
idea_en: A three-layer traffic signal control system using digital twin and agentic AI, where perception layer collects real-time sensor data, conceptualization layer employs LangChain for data processing and traffic flow simulation, and action layer implements optimized control via MCP and traffic APIs.

A real-time traffic light optimization method that dynamically updates a digital twin of transport infrastructure using physical sensors and edge computing to simulate traffic patterns and congestion.
A system integrating LangChain-based data processing with Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge AI decision-making and traffic management APIs for autonomous traffic signal control.
An agentic AI framework for traffic management that autonomously makes real-time decisions on traffic light timing based on continuously updated digital twin simulations.
A method for minimizing traffic waiting time by combining digital twin simulation, edge computing, and large language model-based processing (LangChain) in a closed-loop control system.

title: Intent2Tx: Benchmarking LLMs for Translating Natural Language Intents into Ethereum Transactions
summary: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a transformative interface for Web3, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of translating high-level user intents into functionally correct, state-dependent on-chain transactions. We present \textsc{Intent2Tx}, a high-fidelity benchmark featuring 29,921 single-step and 1,575 multi-step instances meticulously derived from 300 days of real-world Ethereum mainnet traces. Unlike prior works that rely on synthetic instructions, \textsc{Intent2Tx} grounds natural language intents in real-world protocol interactions across 11 categories, including diverse long-tail Decentralized Finance (DeFi) primitives. To enable rigorous evaluation, we propose an execution-aware framework that transcends surface-level text matching by employing differential state analysis on forked mainnet environments. Our extensive evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while scaling and retrieval-augmentation enhance logical consistency and parameter precision, current models struggle with out-of-distribution generalization and multi-step planning. Crucially, our execution-based analysis demonstrates that syntactically valid outputs often fail to achieve intended state transitions, highlighting a significant gap in current "reasoning-to-execution" capabilities. \textsc{Intent2Tx} serves as a critical foundation for developing autonomous, reliable agents in intent-centric Web3 ecosystems. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Intent2Tx_Bench-97FF .

AI.tldr: 提出了Intent2Tx基准，包含29,921个单步和1,575个多步实例，用于评估LLM将用户意图转换为正确以太坊链上交易的能力，发现现有模型在"推理到执行"方面存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法捕捉将高级用户意图转换为功能正确、状态依赖的链上交易的复杂性，缺乏对真实世界DeFi交互的高保真评估。
AI.method: 从300天以太坊主网交易记录中提取真实意图-交易对，构建11类DeFi场景的基准；提出基于分叉主网环境的差异化状态分析框架来评估执行正确性。
AI.result: 评估了16个SOTA LLM，发现扩展模型规模和检索增强可提升逻辑一致性和参数精度，但模型在分布外泛化和多步规划上仍困难；语法有效的输出常无法实现预期的状态转换。
AI.conclusion: Intent2Tx为开发以意图为中心的Web3自主可靠Agent提供了关键基础，揭示了当前LLM在推理到执行能力上的显著差距。
idea_en: An intent-to-transaction conversion system that uses differential state analysis on forked blockchain environments to verify execution correctness beyond syntactic matching.
A benchmark construction method that generates high-fidelity intent-transaction pairs from real-world mainnet traces over extended time periods.
An execution-aware evaluation framework that assesses LLM-generated transactions by comparing state changes against ground-truth intent outcomes in isolated blockchain forks.
A multi-step DeFi transaction planning method that decomposes complex user intents into sequential on-chain actions with state dependency tracking.
A retrieval-augmented generation approach specifically designed for Web3 transaction creation, incorporating on-chain context and protocol specifications.
